units.name: AudioBankEntry
units.summary: Dispatch the selected audio bank to its per-frame channel sequencer.

units.name: RequestAudioSequence
units.summary: Select a sound header from the bank0 pointer table. FE stops the auxiliary sequence and FF stops the main sequence; other requests arbitrate priority independently for the main and auxiliary channels. Bank0 must be selected.

units.name: LoadAudioRequestHeader
units.summary: The header first byte contains separate priority nibbles. The following pointer pairs are installed into four 16-byte channel records; a lower priority request leaves the current stream running.

units.name: InstallMainAudioStreams
units.summary: Copy the two main pointer pairs for each channel, clear its six working bytes and keep only the auxiliary flag in field10. Four records begin at RAM0400.

units.name: CopyAudioHeaderWord
units.summary: Copy one little-endian word from the request header into the current channel record. Source and destination indices advance by two.

units.name: AudioRequestReturn
units.summary: Return without changing the current sequence when priority rejects a request, or after the word-copy helper completes.

units.name: ClearAudioRecordFields
units.summary: Clear the requested number of successive channel fields; the destination index points just before the first field.

units.name: StoreNextAudioField
units.summary: Advance the destination field and store A in the current channel record.

units.name: CheckAuxiliaryAudioPriority
units.summary: Compare the high priority nibble with the active auxiliary priority. On acceptance install four auxiliary pointers, reset their slide state and leave the main stream flag intact.

units.name: InstallAuxiliaryAudioStreams
units.summary: Install auxiliary pointers at record fields11/12. Empty pulse-channel streams clear their enable bit; the remaining header bytes become the shared auxiliary command cursor.

units.name: ClearAuxiliaryAudioState
units.summary: Clear the three auxiliary working fields and retain only the main flag in field10 before advancing to the next channel.

units.name: SetAuxiliaryCommandCursor
units.summary: Point the shared command cursor just beyond the four channel pointers, then reset the divider and loop count.

units.name: StopAuxiliaryAudio
units.summary: Clear auxiliary priority and pointer words in all four records, then silence channels whose main pointer is also empty.

units.name: StopMainAudio
units.summary: Clear main priority and pointer words in all four records, then silence channels whose auxiliary pointer is also empty.

units.name: ClearSelectedAudioPointers
units.summary: Clear the selected two-byte pointer in four 16-byte channel records. The caller chooses field0 or field11.

units.name: SilenceChannelsWithoutOtherStream
units.summary: Walk the channel records and their four-register APU groups. A channel is silenced only if its other stream pointer is empty.

units.name: SilenceCurrentAudioChannel
units.summary: For the final channel disable the DMC bit through APUSTATUS; otherwise clear the current APU group timer pair. The channel countdown selects this special case.

units.name: TickAudioChannels
units.summary: Walk four 16-byte channel records at $0400 upward and four-byte APU register groups. Decrement the shared tick divider; empty sequences issue hardware updates unless their enable-mask bit suppresses them. Bank0 must be selected.

units.name: AudioChannelLoop
units.summary: Check the auxiliary sequence pointer at record offsets 11/12 before the main sequence at 0/1; process active channels and advance both record and APU pointers.

units.name: AudioEmptySequence
units.summary: Select this channel’s enable bit. The last channel uses APUSTATUS; other channels clear their timer-low register when disabled.

units.name: AudioAdvanceChannel
units.summary: Advance the record by 16 bytes and the hardware register pointer by four. Reload the shared tick divider only when it reaches zero.

units.name: AdvanceAudioSlide
units.summary: Between sequence ticks, sign-extend the slide byte at offset13 and accumulate into offset14. At a sequence tick, parse the next auxiliary audio command.

units.name: ReadAuxiliaryAudioCommand
units.summary: Read the shared auxiliary stream when the divider expires. Bit4 selects a control command; otherwise combine two bytes into a four-fractional-bit pitch and read slide/patch fields.

units.name: DecodeAuxiliaryPitch
units.summary: Combine the current command and following byte, shift the pitch left four bits and store it in record fields14/15. The last channel has its own low-bit conversion.

units.name: ReadAuxiliarySlideAndPatch
units.summary: Read the signed slide increment and seven-bit patch index. Preserve the main-stream flag in field10, then refresh the APU registers.

units.name: RestAuxiliaryAudio
units.summary: A zero pitch pair silences this channel and skips two further stream bytes without changing the current command family.

units.name: DispatchAuxiliaryAudioControl
units.summary: The low two bits choose divider reload, counted jump, or sequence termination. This is a compact command stream, not a CPU dispatch table.

units.name: SetAudioTickReload
units.summary: Read the shared divider reload value and continue parsing auxiliary commands.

units.name: LoopAuxiliaryAudioStream
units.summary: Read a repeat count and absolute little-endian target. While the shared count has not reached the limit, install that target; otherwise reset the count and skip it. A zero limit always jumps.

units.name: EndAuxiliaryAudioStream
units.summary: Clear this record auxiliary pointer and shared priority/reload state. Back up the command cursor by one before returning.

units.name: ReadAuxiliaryAudioByte
units.summary: Return the next auxiliary command byte in A and X, advancing the shared little-endian cursor with carry.

units.name: WriteAuxiliaryAudioRegisters
units.summary: Select a three-byte register patch by field10 low seven bits. Combine its timer-high bits with the 12-bit integer part of record14/15, whose low nibble is fractional pitch.

units.name: TickAudioDuration
units.summary: Flag7 at channel offset10 enables an extra duration update on odd audio frames. Offset6 counts in steps of two; zero clears the high flag before parsing the next main audio command.

units.name: ParseMainAudioCommand
units.summary: Clear the fast-tick flag and parse the next note/control byte. Low five bits select note, rest or command; upper bits choose a duration from the bank0 table.

units.name: CheckMainAudioFastTick
units.summary: Command30 sets the field10 sign flag and resumes parsing. Other notes update duration and pitch unless the auxiliary stream owns this channel.

units.name: SetMainAudioPitch
units.summary: For the last channel use the note low nibble directly. Other channels index a little-endian pitch table through record fields7/8, then write the selected register patch.

units.name: EnableMainAudioFastTick
units.summary: Set field10 bit7 and continue parsing immediately. The per-frame entry can then advance the duration twice on alternating frames.

units.name: RestMainAudio
units.summary: Set duration from the upper command bits. If auxiliary audio does not own the channel, disable or zero its timer and update the APU patch.

units.name: DispatchMainAudioControl
units.summary: Mask the command to eight slots and use the inline address-minus-one table through a synthetic RTS. Slots4/5 are zero and their natural selection remains unresolved; table bytes are data.

units.name: AudioCommandTargets
units.summary: Eight little-endian address-minus-one words used by DispatchInlineAudioCommand. Slots4 and5 are zero; the masked selector alone does not prove those slots are naturally selected.

units.name: SetMainAudioPatchPointer
units.summary: Read the low/high patch pointer into record fields2/3 and resume the main stream parser.

units.name: SetMainAudioPatchIndex
units.summary: Read the register-patch index into record field4 and resume parsing.

units.name: SetMainAudioPitchTable
units.summary: Read a pitch-table selector and store base863F plus twice that selector into record fields7/8. This selects a word-aligned pitch source.

units.name: LoopMainAudioStream
units.summary: Use record field9 as a repeat counter, then read an absolute stream pointer. Zero repeats always jump; a completed count resets the counter and skips the pointer.

units.name: ReadMainAudioDurationOverride
units.summary: Read a packed note/duration byte using the alternate duration table at8637, then reuse the note/rest paths.

units.name: EndMainAudioStream
units.summary: Clear this record main cursor and global main priority. Silence only when the auxiliary enable bit does not retain ownership.

units.name: ReadMainAudioByte
units.summary: Read a byte through the cursor in record fields0/1, return it in A and X, and write the incremented cursor back with carry.

units.name: DispatchInlineAudioCommand
units.summary: Pop the caller return address, select one inline little-endian address-minus-one word using X, push its high/low bytes and RTS into that handler. The table is not executable fallthrough.

units.name: SetMainAudioDuration
units.summary: Multiply A by the channel duration factor in field5 using repeated addition and store the byte result in field6. A zero factor wraps the eight-bit loop.

units.name: WriteMainAudioRegisters
units.summary: Select a three-byte patch through record fields2/3 and field4. Write its first two registers, then merge its timer-high bits with fields14/15.

units.name: AudioParametersAndStreams
units.summary: Audio duration tables begin at CPU862F and8637; pitch words begin at863F and request-header pointers at8700. The surrounding bytes contain headers, register patches and compact streams. Exact boundaries of every individual stream remain unresolved.

units.name: Bank6SpriteRecords
units.summary: Sprite pointers and count-prefixed four-byte OAM records read by the bank6 sprite helpers. Individual record bounds and selector domains are not fully recovered.

units.name: UploadSequentialTileRows
units.summary: Initialize two attribute rows, then read destination word, count and first tile from successive records at9AB6. Emit incrementing tile numbers; a zero destination terminates the stream.

units.name: UploadNextSequentialTileRow
units.summary: Latch the PPU destination and emit count successive tile IDs. The stream cursor remains in Y across records.

units.name: DisplayTileRunRecords
units.summary: Nine four-byte records: PPU destination word, nonzero tile count and first tile, then a zero destination terminator. The 9A80 consumer advances exactly to the adjacent 9ADC routine.

units.name: InitializeDisplayAttributeRows
units.summary: Write seven55 bytes at23C9 and23D1 to establish alternating attribute quadrants for the display.

units.name: FillSevenAttributeBytes
units.summary: Write seven copies of55 using the PPU address already selected by the caller.

units.name: FillSixAttributeBytes
units.summary: Write D1 to the PPU address latch and emit six55 bytes. The incoming PPU high-address/latch contract and natural caller remain unresolved.

units.name: Bank6DisplayRecords
units.summary: Pointer words, count-prefixed OAM records and FF-terminated tile streams follow the six-byte PPU helper. These are several data formats; no common record layout is assumed.

units.name: LevelCommandRecords
units.summary: Bank6 level pointer and command records. Fixed engine readers use A000/A001 and A010/A011; the extent and meaning of every individual stream remain unresolved.

units.name: PlayerBankEntry
units.summary: Bank13 gameplay entry jumps to the player update; adjacent slots expose projectile and direction helpers.

units.name: ProjectileBankEntry
units.summary: Update one projectile through the bank13 implementation.

units.name: ThrownObjectBankEntry
units.summary: Bank13 entry into the thrown-object update implementation.

units.name: DirectionBankEntry
units.summary: Resolve an object direction to a banked sprite pointer.

units.name: SignedPaletteStepTable
units.summary: Eight signed offsets -3..4, indexed by the masked low three bits in AC69. Adjacent jump aliases are separate code.

units.name: RequestSoundBank6Alias
units.summary: Mapper selector6 (effective 8KiB bank13 here) entry into the fixed sound request wrapper; the wrapper restores the caller bank.

units.name: TickAreaClearSoundDelayBankAlias
units.summary: Effective 8KiB bank13 entry into the area-clear sound countdown.

units.name: RefreshStatusSpritesBank6Alias
units.summary: Mapper selector6 (effective 8KiB bank13 here) entry into the status OAM refresh routine.

units.name: QueueSelectedTransitionTransferBankAlias
units.summary: Effective 8KiB bank13 entry into the selected transition-transfer descriptor setup.

units.name: EditPaletteWithSecondController
units.summary: Every eighth frame use controller2 directions to increment/decrement a six-bit palette color or move the selected slot modulo16. Draw palette values and the cursor as sprites, then upload the changed first16 palette bytes. Natural activation is unresolved.

units.name: DrawPaletteColorValues
units.summary: Draw sixteen two-digit color values from PaletteShadow at evenly spaced positions, followed by slot values and a selection marker.

units.name: UploadEditedPalette
units.summary: Write the first16 shadow palette bytes to3F00, then restore the PPU address latch sequence.

units.name: DrawPaletteHexByte
units.summary: Build two four-byte OAM records for the high and low hex digits in A. ScratchPtrLo/Hi hold screen X/Y, and scratch05 supplies attributes; X selects the output OAM offset.

units.name: StatusSpriteTemplate
units.summary: Seven four-byte OAM records copied by the explicit 28-byte A858 status refresh loop.

units.name: StatusCoordinatePairs
units.summary: Six coordinate pairs consumed through B0C3/B0C8; the loop advances twice per pair and stops at12.

units.name: RefreshStatusSprites
units.summary: When display flag5 is set and the player is active, copy 28 bytes into the status sprite area and update numeric tile pairs. Mode flags select grenade-count display or fixed tiles; $04A6 appears to be packed decimal.

units.name: StatusGrenadeCount
units.summary: A zero player state clears seven status OAM Y fields. Otherwise choose fixed grenade tiles or packed-decimal digit tiles.

units.name: AdvanceOamRecordScan
units.summary: Advance the OAM cursor by four through the small selected sprite group.

units.name: StatusDecimalDigits
units.summary: Extract the upper and lower packed digits; double each digit for the tile-pair layout. The upper shift count is three because the helper starts at its mask entry.

units.name: DigitToTilePair
units.summary: Double a low digit, then retain an even tile offset in 0..30. Entry at the next instruction accepts an already doubled value.

units.name: SelectPlayerRecord
units.summary: Select RAM $0060 as current object and OAM low offset0. The OAM page is held separately in $F5.

units.name: UpdatePlayer
units.summary: A nonzero delay at $054B suppresses the player update. Otherwise run the main state path and then projectile updates.

units.name: UpdatePlayerState
units.summary: Select the player record. Inactive/transition states branch around ordinary input; mission, area and mode flags choose initialization and animation paths.

units.name: InitializePlayerForArea
units.summary: Copy the player template, choose its input script by AreaIndex and install the first sprite pointer from the bank6 table.

units.name: RenderPlayerDuringTransition
units.summary: Render until the transition countdown expires. Its bit4 controls the extra short wait; area3 chooses a different sound request before control resumes.

units.name: PlayerTransitionGate
units.summary: A nonzero transition selector invokes a fixed-bank helper. Mode flag4 then gates the multi-object negative-state check.

units.name: CheckPlayerMode
units.summary: Mode flag4 waits for active objects to finish; otherwise area and player-state bits select normal movement or the later common path.

units.name: CheckPlayerArea
units.summary: The sign of player control and area0..3 select the active movement path; player bit5 also permits that path in area0.

units.name: MovePlayerIntoTransitionPosition
units.summary: If control bit1 is clear, resume the player continuation and move/render once per frame until player X and the first object Y meet the transition bounds. Then latch bit1 and trigger an effect.

units.name: CheckFirstMissionMode
units.summary: Mission0 and mode flag4 may enter movement; remaining states use the shared player tick path.

units.name: PlayerCommonTick
units.summary: Advance the player timer. A negative state at $0291 invokes an additional sequence; select object $0280 and resume its frame continuation.

units.name: InitializeAreaTransitionObject
units.summary: Wait for the first main slot to become free, install a transition-object template, request palette/background work and drive its movement until Y crosses40.

units.name: AnimateLandingSequence
units.summary: Choose animation tables and Y positions from the $0290 countdown, then render/wait each iteration. The countdown and player control flags coordinate landing motion and the following transition state.

units.name: UpdateAreaTransitionState
units.summary: Coordinate movement, scroll thresholds and PlayerControlState flags. The first object fields19/20 form a countdown; the EC/F0 scroll thresholds depend on mode10. The game-facing transition remains tentative.

units.name: LandingFrame
units.summary: Store the selected Y position, resolve an animation pointer, clear/render sprites and wait one frame before the countdown continues.

units.name: MoveAreaTransitionObject
units.summary: Move the transition object, update shared scroll/effect helpers and yield until its Y reachesC0 or the player crosses the return threshold.

units.name: FinishAreaTransitionObject
units.summary: Set ModeFlagsTwo bit4. For a negative player control state, clear dependent RAM through inline records, reset scroll and conditionally clear area-specific buffers before restarting the player presentation.

units.name: RestartPlayerAfterTransition
units.summary: Clear the first object and player control flags, request palette20 and restart the player at Y=A0 with a six-frame object delay.

units.name: SetPlayerTransitionPresentation
units.summary: Set player state and Y to A0 and defer the object system for six ticks.

units.name: RenderLandingFrame
units.summary: On alternate animation ticks hide the object sprite run before tail-calling the sprite renderer.

units.name: HideSpriteRun
units.summary: Write Y=$F0 into 42 consecutive four-byte OAM entries starting at the current OAM pointer. X and tiles are left unchanged.

units.name: SelectFirstObjectForTransition
units.summary: Select the first main object before reusing the shared transition update path.

units.name: SelectLandingAnimation
units.summary: Clamp the local animation phase to0..11, add the caller’s sequence base, and load a word from banked CPU $8058 into the object sprite pointer.

units.name: CheckPlayerTransitionCoordinates
units.summary: Test an eight-pixel window around the current target. With environment bit0 set, spawn kinds1A and0C choose fixed target coordinates; otherwise compare against the saved target. Return comparison carry to the caller.

units.name: ResumePlayerSequence
units.summary: Select the player and enter its saved continuation; following fragments belong to timed movement/animation sequences.

units.name: InitializePlayerTransitionAnimation
units.summary: Copy a short player template, select sprite5C and render before clearing its timer and continuing the transition animation.

units.name: TimedPlayerMotion
units.summary: Set direction6 to1, move and render while timer advances to64; add a table-selected amount to player Y once per frame.

units.name: TimedPlayerBlink
units.summary: Reset the timer and alternate animation pointers until timer reaches80, then initialize a later motion state.

units.name: MoveTransitionPlayerDownward
units.summary: Render and move with input06 until player Y reaches A0. Restore the normal template and sprite pointer, clear the inline RAM block and request sound03.

units.name: RequestSoundAtInitialScroll
units.summary: Forward A to the sound request only while ScrollHigh equals FD.

units.name: SelectBlinkFrame
units.summary: Timer bit4 chooses even sprite-table offsets $5E or $60.

units.name: ChoosePlayerTransitionBlink
units.summary: Select sprite58 or5A from player timer bit4, then join the established blink-frame path.

units.name: ReadPlayerMovement
units.summary: Refresh status and choose controller1/2 using global flag1. Mask Start/Select from movement; scripted input overrides live input when $04C4 is negative.

units.name: ReadScriptedInputPair
units.summary: Read a direction byte and duration byte through $89/$8A, then advance the script pointer by two. Natural script format beyond these pairs is unresolved.

units.name: PulseScriptedAction
units.summary: Every fourth frame toggle input bit6 before joining the shared input path.

units.name: SuppressPlayerInput
units.summary: A nonzero transition selector supplies zero input; otherwise retain the selected controller/script byte.

units.name: DispatchPlayerMotion
units.summary: Environment flag5 diverts to an alternate anchor; other player-state bits select coupled motion or ordinary movement.

units.name: UseAlternatePosition
units.summary: Copy $98/$99 to player position with a four-unit Y adjustment before rendering. Carry from prior tests is preserved by the original code.

units.name: EnterPlayerEnvironmentTransition
units.summary: Stop scroll, stop auxiliary audio, display a transition sprite and hide it after short waits. Reset scroll/transfer state, place the player at80,C8 and prepare direction-dependent motion; environment bits select the next phase.

units.name: UpdatePlayerEnvironmentTransition
units.summary: Run movement, test object readiness and advance the player timer. Signed environment direction moves scroll and player together until the EE boundary, then clears the direction latch.

units.name: CheckEnvironmentTransitionCompletion
units.summary: Yield, handle player state bit0 and the mode20 retry counter, then test the target coordinate window before resuming movement.

units.name: RestoreAlternatePosition
units.summary: Clear environment flag5 and restore position from $93/$94 with a four-unit Y adjustment; no broad mode meaning is claimed.

units.name: LeavePlayerEnvironmentTransition
units.summary: Display spriteC4, hide it after waits, stop both audio sequences and request pattern/transfer reset before clearing environment state.

units.name: ClearEnvironmentTransitionFlags
units.summary: Clear global bit3, change player state bits2/3, and reset the environment flags and direction latches.

units.name: MoveTransitionPlayerVertically
units.summary: Save the direction byte in scratch96 and add Y:X as a signed fractional/integer step to the player vertical coordinate pair.

units.name: QueueEnvironmentTransitionGraphics
units.summary: Queue several transfer records with increasing offsets, merge the selected environment mode bits, then switch graphics preparation according to environment bit0. The caller resumes after a frame yield.

units.name: QueueSelectedTransitionTransfer
units.summary: Disable NMI while copying a five-byte transfer descriptor from BB65+X. Environment bit0 adds08 to its fourth byte; reenable NMI after installing the descriptor.

units.name: CheckPlayerSpecialState
units.summary: Player bit6 selects a special banked update; otherwise proceed to common movement completion.

units.name: BeginAreaClearWalk
units.summary: Request sound07, set a delayed follow-up sound and background flag20, center the player, then move upward toward the area-specific Y threshold.

units.name: CenterPlayerBeforeAreaClear
units.summary: Repeatedly center the player and yield, allowing the delayed sound timer to advance between frames.

units.name: SelectAreaClearOutcome
units.summary: Area3 enters the completion presentation. Other areas set global transition bit6 and clear bit0 before returning.

units.name: CheckAreaClearCounters
units.summary: Require scratch84 at least0F or scratch83 at least03 before scanning the main object pool for remaining eligible objects. These counters have shared presentation roles elsewhere.

units.name: CheckMainObjectsReadyForTransition
units.summary: Scan eight32-byte object records. Return carry clear when an active object matches the field16 condition; return carry set when none does. Player state bit2 chooses the field comparison.

units.name: CenterPlayerHorizontally
units.summary: Choose left/right input from player X and move/render toward X=80. Return carry clear while moving; equality retains the carry from CMP as the completion result.

units.name: PresentAreaCompletion
units.summary: Wait for the residual walk timer, change audio/palette state and animate a six-position sprite presentation. Then show mission messages, conditional status rewards and the final-mission text before resetting or advancing progression.

units.name: AnimateAreaCompletionSprites
units.summary: Cycle sprite choices at six coordinate pairs, repeating45 times with an eight-frame delay. Finish by selecting the completion palette/audio and first text record.

units.name: ShowMissionCompletionMessages
units.summary: Draw the common congratulatory text and a mission-selected record. Mission0B adds an extra record; later branches use status and final-mission conditions.

units.name: CheckCompletionStatusMessage
units.summary: If RAM04A4 reaches50, show three additional message records and an effect before the normal completion delay. The precise score/status meaning is unresolved.

units.name: ShowFinalMissionMessages
units.summary: Mission0F and later show the final messages. A status/grenade packed-value condition unlocks two additional records. After three long waits, clear mission/area/status and request the next global transition.

units.name: ResumePlayerAfterAreaClear
units.summary: Restore the PPU sprite-size flag, request sound09, mark the player completion control state and clear the first object's continuation fields before rejoining the common player tick.

units.name: RestoreCompletionPpuState
units.summary: Clear the completion status counter and set PPUCTRL shadow bit5.

units.name: TickAreaClearSoundDelay
units.summary: Count scratch70 down; on expiry request sound11 for areas3/7 or sound08 otherwise.

units.name: AdvancePlayerActionCounter
units.summary: Increment the low action counter and carry into its high byte before joining the shared action finish path.

units.name: FinishPlayerAction
units.summary: Advance timer; player bit0 and mode flags gate a ten-step state counter and sound/event request before common movement completion.

units.name: PlayerModeActionGate
units.summary: A negative mode byte decrements player state; other modes request sound0B and begin the terrain-dependent return animation.

units.name: BeginPlayerReturnAnimation
units.summary: Clear mode20 and the retry counter, stop scroll and choose a terrain-dependent player animation. Three banked sprite words or alternate sprites are displayed before normal transition flags resume.

units.name: RequestPlayerEvent
units.summary: Request sound0B through the fixed bank-switching wrapper, then begin the player return animation.

units.name: FinishPlayerReturnAnimation
units.summary: Wait, clear environment transition state and choose the area-clear walk when its object/counter conditions hold; otherwise request the global transition.

units.name: RequestGlobalPlayerTransition
units.summary: Set global bit5 and transfer bit7, clear environment state, stop auxiliary audio and clear ModeFlagsOne. Increment/decrement preserves PlayerState while updating processor flags.

units.name: DrawMessageAsSprites
units.summary: X:Y points to a record: count, starting X, starting Y, OAM offset, then characters. Space skips an OAM slot,80 hides a sprite, each character advances X by8 and decrements Y. Writes four-byte OAM entries to RAM0700.

units.name: MissionMessageRecords
units.summary: Count and screen-position prefixes followed by congratulatory and mission text. The CPU B305 streamer converts these records into OAM entries.

units.name: FinishPlayerMovement
units.summary: Clear player bit1, reset collision result, resolve terrain and clamp coordinates. A temporary Y=$F8 hides a negative collision result during rendering.

units.name: RenderPlayerAndScroll
units.summary: Resolve direction graphics, render while preserving Y, choose sprite attribute phase under mode flag5, then update scroll and movement velocity.

units.name: InitializeStatusSprite
units.summary: For A in 0..3, initialize one OAM sprite at 07D0: X/Y=20, attributes=02 and tile from the four-byte table. No natural caller is established.

units.name: StatusSpriteTileChoices
units.summary: Four tile choices used by InitializeStatusSprite with caller-supplied index0..3; natural selector is unknown.

units.name: UpdatePlayerProjectiles
units.summary: Spawn and update the six small projectiles, then select the $0450 thrown-object record and its OAM offset.

units.name: ResolveDirectionSprite
units.summary: Direction low nibble selects an index through one of four banked lookup tables. Direction bits4/5 and object bit1 choose which lookup; offset7 bit3 selects an alternate sprite-pointer set at CPU $8000.

units.name: ChooseDirectionLookup
units.summary: Search the appropriate direction domain for an exact match. The routine assumes a valid direction; no bounded fallback is present.

units.name: LoadDirectionSpritePointer
units.summary: Use twice the direction index plus the variant offset to load object fields10/11. Return the original index in A.

units.name: UpdateThrownObject
units.summary: A negative input/action byte spawns an inactive record at $0450. In ordinary mode decrement $04A6 with decimal correction; copy player position and initialize a four-unit vertical velocity.

units.name: SpawnThrownObject
units.summary: Activate the record, set its position and timer, clear auxiliary fields and start vertical velocity at $0400. Its path and splash-like termination suggest a grenade.

units.name: TickThrownObject
units.summary: Skip inactive records. Increment age; a descending velocity and height threshold switch to a timed terminal animation.

units.name: ThrownObjectTerminalAnimation
units.summary: Set active-effect flag $045E, render until age32, then clear effect/mode bits through a helper.

units.name: IntegrateThrownObject
units.summary: Choose an animation pair by age, subtract $12 from 16-bit vertical velocity, subtract velocity from position, then add scrolling displacement and render.

units.name: TickThrownObjectFuse
units.summary: Advance record timer7. At60 request sound11 and test a28-pixel player-centered damage box. For the following20 ticks select an effect, then clear the object; earlier ticks select graphics from a timed table and apply vertical/scroll motion.

units.name: AnimateThrownObjectExplosion
units.summary: Subtract60 from the fuse and retain an effect for20 ticks; then clear the object record through the shared helper.

units.name: MoveThrownObjectBeforeExplosion
units.summary: Choose a sprite pair from fuse bits, add the indexed vertical step and ScrollDelta to its fractional/integer Y pair, then join shared projectile drawing.

units.name: ThrownObjectParameters
units.summary: Alternating object parameter pairs read by indexed thrown-object initialization paths. Individual array boundaries and natural indices remain unresolved.

units.name: AbortPlayerMotion
units.summary: Discard two saved values from the stack, set player bit0, clear input and jump to the event request. This entry depends on the caller’s stack layout.

units.name: ResolvePlayerTerrain
units.summary: Test X and Y movement independently: temporarily mask one axis in the input, move, query terrain, and restore a coordinate for blocking results. Terrain codes1/3 depend on global flag3.

units.name: TestPlayerYAxis
units.summary: Restore the input after the X test and perform the analogous Y test; collision result can mark a hidden state or abort movement.

units.name: ClampPlayerPosition
units.summary: Special player bits first test transition coordinates; normal limits are X8..248 and Y16/152..210 depending on state.

units.name: FinishPlayerScrollTransfer
units.summary: Choose a graphics preparation helper from signed environment direction, enable NMI, select mapper bank6 and resume the player-limit path.

units.name: ChoosePlayerLowerLimit
units.summary: Player bit6 changes the lower Y bound; clamp Y and X without touching fractional position bytes.

units.name: AdjustPlayerVelocity
units.summary: Process the four high direction bits. Helpers adjust two signed 16-bit velocity pairs at $75/$76 and $77/$78 by $30.

units.name: LimitDownwardPlayerVelocity
units.summary: Add a velocity step only while the signed vertical integer component remains below06.

units.name: LimitLeftwardPlayerVelocity
units.summary: Subtract a horizontal velocity step unless it is already below the negative limit.

units.name: LimitRightwardPlayerVelocity
units.summary: Add a horizontal velocity step unless its nonnegative integer component has reached05.

units.name: AdjustVelocityAxisX
units.summary: Skip the adjustment if horizontal direction bits are nonzero; otherwise select the first velocity pair.

units.name: AdjustVelocityAxisY
units.summary: Skip the adjustment if vertical direction bits are nonzero; otherwise select the second velocity pair.

units.name: AdjustSignedVelocity
units.summary: A nonzero velocity with a negative high byte adds $30 to its low byte; other selected paths subtract $30 as a 16-bit value. Preserve this asymmetric original carry behavior.

units.name: StoreVelocityStepCarry
units.summary: Propagate carry from the fractional velocity addition into the selected integer component.

units.name: SubtractVelocityStep
units.summary: Subtract $0030 from the selected low/high velocity pair.

units.name: UpdateDirectionVelocity
units.summary: Find the direction index; differences of1 or7 keep the current vector. Other turns copy four bytes from banked CPU $BA96 into record offsets21..24 and normalize the saved index.

units.name: TrySpawnProjectile
units.summary: Require a new bit6 action and an available slot in the $0200 pool. Latch the action until released; scanned slots are16 bytes apart.

units.name: FindProjectileSlot
units.summary: Latch this action and scan seven16-byte records for a nonnegative state. The selected slot then receives player position, motion, sprite and lifetime fields in InitializeAllocatedProjectile. Ordinary traversal still visits only six slots.

units.name: InitializeAllocatedProjectile
units.summary: Copy player X/Y and four motion bytes into the selected16-byte projectile record. Set timer20, or40 and sprite18 in the alternate mode; set attribute01 and request sound0F. Allocation scans seven slots, while ordinary update/hit traversal scans six; this does not establish a separate role for slot7.

units.name: UpdateProjectilePool
units.summary: Walk six 16-byte records at $0200 with four-byte OAM entries. Only negative state bytes are active.

units.name: TickProjectile
units.summary: State bit0 or an expired lifetime removes the projectile. Late lifetime and terrain code can alter its sprite/timer; then integrate two 16-bit position/velocity pairs.

units.name: MoveProjectile
units.summary: Reject Y>=240, add velocities at offsets10..13 into X/Y fractional pairs1..4, and add scrolling displacement to Y.

units.name: RenderProjectile
units.summary: A flag in the OAM-side record bypasses masking; otherwise consult the fixed renderer helper, hide when needed, and emit the four-byte sprite.

units.name: RemoveProjectile
units.summary: Set object Y to240, clear its state and emit the hidden sprite through the continuation below.

units.name: ClearProjectileAndHideSprite
units.summary: Clear the selected projectile state and emit its hidden sprite through the shared single-sprite helper.

units.name: PlayerAndProjectileInitializers
units.summary: Repeated player/projectile fields and motion parameters copied into RAM records by nearby initializers. Individual record meanings remain partly unresolved.

units.name: AdvanceVerticalScroll
units.summary: Clear this frame’s displacement first. Ordinary upward input above Y153 subtracts $B0 from the fractional scroll and updates the two scroll bytes with wrap and end-of-area handling.

units.name: WrapVerticalScroll
units.summary: Wrap the middle scroll byte by240, carrying into its high byte. A particular end state sets player bit6 unless mode flag4 suppresses it.

units.name: PublishAreaScrollTransition
units.summary: Stop auxiliary audio and request sound05. Except for area3 modulo4, set background request bit6 before the shared scroll flag return.

units.name: PublishScrollFlags
units.summary: Merge the row-boundary result into render flags and return.

units.name: GameplayInitializationRecords
units.summary: Initialization fields, sprite parameters and pointer words used by the bank13 gameplay routines. Exact bounds of every logical record remain unresolved.

units.name: MapperIdentityBytes
units.summary: Values00 through07 provide bus-conflict-safe backing for mapper2 writes. The selected ROM byte equals the value written; mapper selectors describe16KiB banks, unlike the effective8KiB execution contexts.

units.name: DelayFramesEntry
units.summary: Entry alias for the continuation-saving frame delay; A supplies the delay count.

units.name: ResumeObjectEntry
units.summary: Fixed-bank trampoline for object continuation scheduling.

units.name: CopyBytesEntry
units.summary: Fixed-bank trampoline for the byte-counted memory copy.

units.name: UploadInitialPaletteAlias
units.summary: Fixed entry into the initial32-byte palette preset upload.

units.name: AdvanceMissionEntry
units.summary: Entry alias for mission/area advancement and accumulated status update.

units.name: WritePpuScrollAlias
units.summary: Fixed entry into the PPU scroll-latch writer.

units.name: ClearRamWithCountXYAlias
units.summary: Fixed entry into the RAM-clear tail: X/Y supply high/low count and InlineClearDestination supplies the destination.

units.name: UploadSpritePaletteEntry
units.summary: Upload X palette bytes through a caller-supplied pointer.

units.name: YieldOneFrame
units.summary: Set a one-frame continuation delay and save the caller return address in the current object record; the scheduler unwinds it on a later update.

units.name: UploadScreenTextAlias
units.summary: Fixed entry into the screen text-record uploader.

units.name: UploadPalettePresetEntry
units.summary: Use the first fixed palette preset.

units.name: UploadOtherPalettePresetEntry
units.summary: Use the second fixed palette preset.

units.name: ClearObjectBuffersEntry
units.summary: Normal wrapper around the internal pair of inline clears. This wrapper consumes no inline bytes in its own caller.

units.name: ClearInlineRamEntry
units.summary: Direct alias for the four-byte inline RAM clear contract. The caller's next bytes supply destination/count and are skipped on return.

units.name: SavePlayerCheckpointAlias
units.summary: Fixed entry into saving player/background checkpoint state.

units.name: RestorePlayerCheckpointAlias
units.summary: Fixed entry into restoring player/background checkpoint state.

units.name: ClearBothNametablesAlias
units.summary: Fixed entry into clearing both nametables.

units.name: DisableNmiEntry
units.summary: Fixed entry alias for clearing the NMI control bit.

units.name: EnableNmiEntry
units.summary: Fixed entry alias for setting the NMI control bit.

units.name: HideAllSpritesEntry
units.summary: Fixed entry alias for hiding all64 OAM sprites.

units.name: DelayThirtyFrames
units.summary: Yield through the continuation saver for30 frames.

units.name: FlashPaletteFirstEntry
units.summary: Select the first 16-byte flashing palette.

units.name: FlashPaletteSecondEntry
units.summary: Select the second 16-byte flashing palette.

units.name: DelaySixtyFrames
units.summary: Yield through the continuation saver for60 frames.

units.name: AccumulateMissionStatusEntry
units.summary: Fixed entry alias for the packed-decimal status accumulator.

units.name: DelayOneHundredTwentyFrames
units.summary: Yield through the continuation saver for120 frames.

units.name: ShowMissionDigitsEntry
units.summary: Entry alias for the mission/area sprite digits.

units.name: HideMissionDigitsEntry
units.summary: Entry alias that moves the mission/area sprite digits offscreen.

units.name: ResetHardwareAndRam
units.summary: Disable interrupts, initialize the CPU stack and PPU/APU state, wait for vblank, then upload the initial palette. Inline records clear the designated RAM ranges; initialize nametables/OAM before enabling rendering and the main frame loop.

units.name: NmiHandler
units.summary: Save A/X/Y, disable NMI/rendering while processing queued VRAM work, select bank6 and update fixed helpers. DMA OAM page7, advance the frame counter, restore scroll/rendering and restore the selected bank before returning.

units.name: NmiBankedWork
units.summary: Select bank6; mode flag6 conditionally runs the second-controller palette editor at CPU A720.

units.name: NmiSpritesAndScroll
units.summary: Run the fixed display update, DMA sprites, update nametable/scroll control, enable NMI/rendering and restore the saved program bank before RTI.

units.name: UploadQueuedTerminatedStream
units.summary: Select bank6, set the queued PPU destination and copy the queued byte count. FF introduces a new low nametable address under high20; it is a stream control byte rather than output data.

units.name: MainFrameLoop
units.summary: Wait for the NMI counter to differ from the consumed value. A controller2 combination and unlock flag may bypass the wait. Poll input, select audio bank0, tick sound unless paused, then select bank6 and update the main state machine.

units.name: ConsumeFrame
units.summary: Remember the frame, poll controllers and run the audio/game bank sequence.

units.name: SelectProgramBank
units.summary: A is a 16KiB mapper2 selector, saved at $04C7 for NMI restoration. Store at $C000+A preserves the cartridge bus-conflict convention; it is not an effective8KiB bank index.

units.name: SetScrollNametable
units.summary: Derive PPUCTRL nametable bit1 from scroll-high bit0 while preserving the other control flags.

units.name: UploadSpritePalette
units.summary: A/Y supply source high/low; upload to PPU $3F10. X supplies length from the caller.

units.name: UploadPaletteAndMirror
units.summary: Copy X bytes from ScratchPtr+Y to PPUDATA and the 05C0 shadow, then use the shared palette-upload exit. Caller supplies a valid PPU address/latch, pointer, index and nonzero count; natural caller is unknown.

units.name: UploadPalettePresetTwo
units.summary: Select fixed CPU $C27B as a32-byte palette source.

units.name: UploadPalettePresetOne
units.summary: Select fixed CPU $C25B as a32-byte palette source.

units.name: UploadInitialPalettePreset
units.summary: Select the32-byte palette at C23B and fall into the shared palette uploader.

units.name: UploadPalette32
units.summary: Set length32 and join the common palette uploader.

units.name: UploadPaletteAtZero
units.summary: A/Y supply source high/low; upload X bytes to PPU $3F00 and mirror them in RAM $05B0.

units.name: UploadPaletteFromPointer
units.summary: Use A:Y as the source high/low bytes and X as the count. Write to PPU3F00 while maintaining PaletteShadow, then restore the address latch sequence.

units.name: PaletteUploadLoopSetup
units.summary: Finish the PPU address and stream bytes, maintaining a palette shadow used by later effects.

units.name: CopyPaletteToPpuAndShadow
units.summary: Copy exactly X bytes through the shared source pointer, updating both PPUDATA and the palette RAM shadow.

units.name: ResetPaletteAddressLatch
units.summary: Reset PPU address through $3F00 and two additional zero writes; preserve the original latch sequence.

units.name: RestorePalettePpuLatch
units.summary: Reset the PPU address latch with the3F00 sequence after palette transfers.

units.name: UploadPaletteShadow
units.summary: Upload16 bytes from the RAM palette shadow at $05B0.

units.name: UploadPaletteShadowHalf
units.summary: Upload16 bytes from the palette shadow through the shared pointer/count entry.

units.name: SelectSecondFlashPalette
units.summary: Alternate entry chooses table offset16; entry at $C1FE chooses offset0.

units.name: UploadUpperFlashPaletteHalf
units.summary: Use X=16 to select the upper half of the first flash palette.

units.name: SelectFirstFlashPalette
units.summary: Choose table offset0 for the 16-byte flash palette.

units.name: UploadLowerFlashPaletteHalf
units.summary: Use X=0 to select the lower half of the first flash palette. Its16-iteration loop always branches over the following palette data.

units.name: UploadFlashPalette
units.summary: Stream16 bytes from CPU $C21B+X to PPU $3F00, then reset the palette address latch.

units.name: FlashPalettePresets
units.summary: Four32-byte NES palettes at CPU C21B/C23B/C25B/C27B. The first is read as two16-byte halves; the others use32-byte uploads. The preceding DEY/BNE loop ends with zero set, so its BEQ skips these bytes; the former fallthrough instruction interpretation is superseded.

units.name: UploadCountedTextTiles
units.summary: Set PPU address from X:Y and emit scratch51 bytes from the pointer at4F/50, forcing tile bit7. FF selects a repeated-fill tail whose next byte fills the remaining count.

units.name: FillRemainingTextTiles
units.summary: Read the fill tile following FF and repeat it for the remaining output count.

units.name: ClearBothNametables
units.summary: Disable rendering, fill nametables2000 and2800, then return with the PPU address advanced through their attribute bytes.

units.name: FillNametableAndAttributes
units.summary: Write tileA0 across960 tile cells, then64 zero attribute bytes. The first row counter starts at C0; subsequent outer iterations wrap the byte counter through256 writes.

units.name: HideAllOamSprites
units.summary: Set the Y byte of every four-byte OAM record to F4. Other sprite bytes are retained.

units.name: WritePpuScroll
units.summary: Reset the PPU latch and write horizontal scroll0 and the current vertical-scroll byte.

units.name: LatchControllers
units.summary: Pulse controller strobe high then low. X returns0 for the first controller reader.

units.name: PollControllersAndStartEdge
units.summary: Preserve the previous controller1 Start bit, sample both controllers, and set $04CA to1 for a new press,255 for release, or0 when unchanged.

units.name: ReadBothControllerLines
units.summary: Read bit0 from ports1/2, relatch, then read bit1. A nonzero second-line result replaces the first; this accommodates an alternate input line.

units.name: ReadControllerBitZero
units.summary: Read eight serial bits into a byte using a shift-and-merge loop; controller result is stored at $47+X.

units.name: ReadControllerBitOne
units.summary: Read serial bit1 instead of bit0. Only a nonzero result overwrites the earlier controller sample.

units.name: ClearRamFromInlineArguments
units.summary: Disable NMI, pop the JSR return, save return+4 with carry, then read destination/count words from the four inline bytes. Clear RAM through a16-bit pointer and byte counters. A zero low count processes full256-byte chunks; the helper consumes its caller's inline data.

units.name: ClearRamWithCountXY
units.summary: Enter with destination already installed and X/Y holding high/low count. Save the count and join the zero-fill loop.

units.name: ClearInlineRamByteLoop
units.summary: Store zero, advance the destination pointer with carry and count down the low byte. The high count supplies additional256-byte chunks.

units.name: CopyByteCount
units.summary: A is an8-bit length, X/Y destination high/low, $0F/$10 source. Copy and increment high bytes on Y wrap; count0 means256 bytes. The loop also depends on destination-high remaining nonzero after wrap.

units.name: SaveObjectContinuation
units.summary: Store delay at object offset29 and pop the caller return low/high into offsets30/31. RTS then returns to the caller’s caller; this is cooperative stack scheduling.

units.name: ResumeObjectContinuation
units.summary: If delay is zero return normally. Otherwise decrement it; while waiting discard this call’s return address. At zero replace it with the stored continuation so RTS resumes just after the original yield.

units.name: UpdateGlobalState
units.summary: Increment a local tick and select the zero-page global record at $0040. Check controller2 sequences when enabled, resume a continuation, then dispatch global-state bits.

units.name: InitializeGlobalState
units.summary: Mark global state active and upload32 text tiles from CPU C742 to PPU3F00 through the counted text helper.

units.name: InitializeTitleMenu
units.summary: Reset scroll and random seed, clear inline RAM blocks, initialize nametables/OAM and draw title text. The menu polls Start/Select and updates its sprite cursor on a timed loop; idle timeout starts a scripted area demonstration.

units.name: PrepareTitleMenuBuffers
units.summary: Disable NMI, clear gameplay/menu buffers from inline records and reset the title transfer/input-script state before rendering the menu.

units.name: PollTitleMenuSelection
units.summary: Start/Select breaks the timed menu loop. Otherwise decrement the timeout and start a demonstration unless the saved menu state requests another cycle.

units.name: HandleTitleMenuButtons
units.summary: Start enters new-game setup. Select changes the mode choice; the unlock flag and held high button bit also permit mission advancement/display.

units.name: AdvanceTitleMenuChoice
units.summary: Request menu audio, reload the timeout and increment the mode index with a mask determined by the saved menu state.

units.name: DrawTitleMenuCursor
units.summary: Build two OAM sprites at the selected menu row, with fixed tiles74/76 and X positions48/50.

units.name: ApplyTitleMenuMode
units.summary: Move the menu choice mode bit into GlobalState bit2, preserving its other bits.

units.name: HideMissionDigitSprites
units.summary: Move the three mission/area digit sprites to Y=F0 through their shared layout path.

units.name: DrawMissionDigitSprites
units.summary: Derive area and mission digit tiles, then position three attribute01 sprites on the mission display row.

units.name: AcceptTitleStart
units.summary: Recognize the exact D0 controller chord only with the unlock flag, then choose its mode flag and apply the menu mode.

units.name: InitializeNewGameBuffers
units.summary: Disable NMI, set active global flags and use inline clears to reset session buffers. A demonstration preserves its supplied area; ordinary menu choices can clear the progression block.

units.name: InitializeNewGameInventory
units.summary: After the session clears, set lives/status03 and grenade count05 in both player banks, clear transfer and background state, reset object buffers and enable NMI. This is the supported post-clear interception used by the saved artificial later-stage visits.

units.name: DispatchGlobalState
units.summary: Priority is bit6, bit5, bit3, then bit0. Each selects a distinct transition/update path; game-facing names for every state remain unresolved.

units.name: UpdateActiveGlobalState
units.summary: When player/display flags permit, update status sprites. Start edges can cancel the script or toggle pause, then timeout and player-bank logic run.

units.name: HandleStartEdge
units.summary: A new Start press with button bits set cancels a negative script state, resets area/render flags and yields. Otherwise it may toggle pause outside a special scroll-high value.

units.name: TogglePause
units.summary: Ignore inactive control or scroll-high=$FD. Toggle pause bit0 and mute or enable APU channels using that bit.

units.name: TickScriptTimeout
units.summary: Advance a two-byte timeout only for a negative script state. At high byte4 clear the script, counters and continuation state before a fixed helper.

units.name: ReturnToTitleAfterSession
units.summary: Hide sprites, clear the inline session block and reenter title initialization.

units.name: UpdateUnpausedGame
units.summary: Pause bit0 suppresses player update. Otherwise select bank6, call its gameplay entry and optionally update fixed object systems.

units.name: SelectGameplayBank
units.summary: Same mapper2 saved-bank contract as SelectProgramBank, with A as a16KiB selector.

units.name: ClearSessionObjectBuffers
units.summary: Perform three inline RAM clears and return normally to the caller. The inline records belong to this routine.

units.name: InitializeEnvironmentTransition
units.summary: Environment bit0 gates a one-time helper; player bit3 permits an additional transition helper, then rejoin active-state processing.

units.name: PrepareGameplayRestart
units.summary: Disable NMI, hide sprites and clear render/global transition bits before the common restart path.

units.name: FillNametableOnEightTickCadence
units.summary: Increment scratch5F and act only when its low three bits wrap. Select nametable2000 or2800 from scratch4A bit0, increment scratch5E and fill176 bytes with it. Natural caller and intended visual effect remain unresolved.

units.name: TitleTileRowPrefix
units.summary: Four bytes00/04/08/0C at the explicit C742 text-source origin. The counted reader can overlap later code; this prefix does not establish an exclusive32-byte table.

units.name: DrawTitleScreenRecords
units.summary: Disable rendering, request audio0E and upload the fixed text records. Select bank6 for its sequential tile-row helper, finish the remaining records and restore rendering/scroll.

units.name: ScreenTextRecords
units.summary: Screen text pointer/position records used by CPU C878 and the counted PPU uploader. Individual text-record domains remain unresolved.

units.name: UploadScreenTextRecord
units.summary: X:Y points to a five-byte descriptor: byte count, source low/high and PPU destination low/high. Load those fields and tail-call the counted text uploader.

units.name: UpdateStatusDigitSprites
units.summary: Skip selected scroll/area states. Choose one of two six-digit records, rotate a per-frame OAM destination, and write digit tile pairs at fixed Y16 with descending X positions.

units.name: EmitStatusDigitSprites
units.summary: Read a digit, double it for the tile index, and emit one OAM record. Wrap the output index within24 bytes while walking the selected digit record backward.

units.name: BeginGlobalBitFivePath
units.summary: Clear the area-effect progress counter, save the player/background checkpoint and enter the life-loss restart path.

units.name: RestartAfterLifeLoss
units.summary: Clear player/object state, wait120 frames and decrement the active lives/status byte. If exhausted, enter game over; otherwise optionally swap player records and restore the saved background state, enforcing at least five grenades.

units.name: SwapPlayerProgressRecords
units.summary: Save three scroll bytes, then exchange17 bytes of current and alternate status/progression records using the CPU stack as a one-byte temporary.

units.name: ClearPlayerPresentationState
units.summary: Clear player/render visibility state before the two inline object-buffer clears.

units.name: ClearObjectBuffers
units.summary: Clear two internal RAM ranges through inline argument records. This routine returns normally and consumes no bytes from its own caller.

units.name: SavePlayerBackgroundCheckpoint
units.summary: Save player control and background row/request state, forcing request bit0 in the saved copy.

units.name: RestorePlayerBackgroundCheckpoint
units.summary: Restore the saved player control, row and request state for the common restart path.

units.name: HandleGameOver
units.summary: Stop the transfer, request audio0A and wait. Compare the selected six-byte score record lexicographically with the saved best score and copy it when greater/equal. Continue with the other player if available; otherwise restore title global flags.

units.name: DisableNmiControl
units.summary: Write PPUCTRL0 to suppress NMI/control flags during the update.

units.name: EnableNmiControl
units.summary: Merge NMI-enable bit7 with the saved PPU control byte and write PPUCTRL.

units.name: BeginGlobalBitSixPath
units.summary: Clear transfer state and player presentation state before presenting the area summary.

units.name: PresentAreaSummary
units.summary: Clear display state, draw summary text and choose an animated sprite record. A compact message script queues characters or area-number substitutions with timed audio and sprite updates, then awards the status amount and advances mission state.

units.name: ParseAreaSummaryMessage
units.summary: Bytes below FC queue one character; FC inserts the current area string, FD inserts the next area modulo8, FE loads a new screen position and FF finishes. The script pointer overlays player-coordinate RAM in this presentation.

units.name: QueueSummaryAreaNumber
units.summary: Convert the selected area to a three-byte source record, queue it at the current screen position and advance the horizontal position by two.

units.name: SetSummaryTextPosition
units.summary: Read screen position bytes following FE and advance the script cursor past that three-byte control.

units.name: QueueSummaryCharacter
units.summary: Queue one byte from the current script cursor at its current PPU destination, then advance pointer and position.

units.name: AnimateSummaryWhileTyping
units.summary: Yield while updating the four-frame typing timer. Every15 animation ticks choose the next banked sprite pair and render the first main object; preserve the presentation object pointer afterward.

units.name: FinishAreaSummaryAndAwardStatus
units.summary: Queue the summary graphics, display the packed status digits, convert the value to a16-bit shifted award and apply an extra threshold bonus. After waiting, advance mission/area and dispatch the next global state.

units.name: StaffMessageRecords
units.summary: ASCII staff message and display parameters preceding CPU CC53. The text is readable, but the parameter fields are not fully interpreted.

units.name: AdvanceMissionAndArea
units.summary: Increment MissionIndex modulo16 and AreaIndex modulo4, then fall into the status accumulator.

units.name: AccumulatePackedMissionStatus
units.summary: Add the current mission amount to the accumulated packed-decimal byte, correcting the low digit when it reaches ten, then clear the current amount.

units.name: AreaMessageCommands
units.summary: Scripted area-message bytes using FE/FC/FD/FF controls, read by the CPU CA7C loop. Three trailing parameter bytes precede the separate controller selector; no larger shared schema is assumed.

units.name: SelectAudioRequestWithController
units.summary: On every16th tick use controller directions to increment/decrement a five-bit request value. A further button submits it to audio, and the value is rendered as two hex digits through a text descriptor. Natural caller remains unresolved.

units.name: CheckControllerTwoSequences
units.summary: Only process unlock sequences while controller1 is idle. Six progress bytes at $FA..$FF select expected controller2 bytes and completion bits in $04C8.

units.name: SetUnlockFlag
units.summary: Merge the completed sequence’s bit into $04C8 and return.

units.name: CheckLastUnlockSequence
units.summary: The sixth sequence uses table offset52 and completion bit1.

units.name: MatchControllerSequenceStep
units.summary: Progress bit0 alternates release and press requirements. Nonzero input must equal the expected table byte; a zero next byte marks completion in carry.

units.name: AdvanceUnlockSequence
units.summary: Increment this sequence’s progress and return carry clear.

units.name: ResetUnlockSequence
units.summary: On mismatch clear the selected sequence-progress byte and return normally.

units.name: ControllerSequenceRecords
units.summary: Expected controller masks and sequence parameters used by CPU CD76/CD98. Natural selection and exact bounds of each sequence remain unresolved.

units.name: ObjectSystemEntry
units.summary: Fixed-bank trampoline for the32-byte object pool and spawn system.

units.name: EmitSingleSpriteEntry
units.summary: Fixed-bank trampoline for four-byte OAM output.

units.name: MoveObjectEntry
units.summary: Fixed-bank trampoline for direction-controlled fixed-point movement.

units.name: CullObjectEntryAlias
units.summary: Fixed entry alias for the screen-edge culling helper.

units.name: HideSingleObjectSpriteAlias
units.summary: Fixed entry into one-sprite object removal.

units.name: RenderObjectEntry
units.summary: Fixed-bank trampoline for multi-sprite rendering.

units.name: TestPlayerOverlapPreparedAlias
units.summary: Fixed entry into player overlap testing after half extents have already been stored in WorkByteOrPtrLo/Hi.

units.name: UpdateTransitionObjectAlias
units.summary: Fixed entry alias for the shared transition-object helper.

units.name: SelectObjectEffectEntry
units.summary: Fixed-bank trampoline for an effect animation selector.

units.name: ClearObjectEntry
units.summary: Fixed-bank trampoline to clear active state through the removal helper.

units.name: CheckSpriteMaskEntry
units.summary: Fixed-bank trampoline for stage/environment sprite masking.

units.name: ApplyObjectEffectAlias
units.summary: Fixed entry alias for the indexed object-effect helper.

units.name: LoadSpritePairAlias
units.summary: Fixed entry alias for the banked sprite-pair lookup.

units.name: AddStatusAmountAlias
units.summary: Fixed entry alias for the multi-byte status award helper.

units.name: SelectSpritePointerEntry
units.summary: Fixed-bank trampoline to resolve a banked sprite-pointer pair.

units.name: SpawnParameterRecordAlias
units.summary: Fixed entry alias for the parameter-record spawn helper.

units.name: RequestSoundEntry
units.summary: Entry alias for the bank-switching audio request wrapper.

units.name: RequestSoundThroughBankZero
units.summary: Ignore request1E and all requests during scripted demonstrations. Otherwise preserve the request in X, select bank0, call its request parser at8003 and restore bank6. This wrapper changes the lower execution windows.

units.name: SelectObjectPool
units.summary: Select the first32-byte object record at RAM $0280.

units.name: UpdateObjectSystem
units.summary: Honor a nonzero delay at $054A. Mode/player/area flags gate the object system before spawn-stream processing and pool updates.

units.name: InitializeObjectSystem
units.summary: Bit7 of $F0 latches initialization. A particular area/scroll state selects initial spawn bytes, then render flag7 gates the per-frame work.

units.name: AdvanceSpawnCoordinateCopy
units.summary: Advance both indices across the eight-byte coordinate copy.

units.name: CheckObjectRenderFlag
units.summary: Only render flag7 allows stream/pool work. First update the spawn queue, then hide38 OAM records starting at $0730.

units.name: ChooseObjectBudget
units.summary: Normally update eight object slots; a special player state and selector reduce the pass to one. A transition selector aborts the pass.

units.name: RotateObjectSlotOrder
units.summary: Start from $0540 mod8 and choose each slot’s OAM offset through CPU $CE3E. Update objects and the pseudo-random state, advancing the32-byte pointer.

units.name: RefillInactiveObjects
units.summary: Outside player bit2 mode, a nonzero spawn control permits scanning backward over eight slots and initializing inactive type fields.

units.name: CopySpawnYWithOffset
units.summary: Choose destination field16 before joining the shared spawn-coordinate copy.

units.name: TickObjectScheduling
units.summary: Advance the rotating slot counter. Some player states skip projectiles; every fourth global frame scan the five auxiliary slots for an inactive record.

units.name: InitializeAuxiliaryObject
units.summary: Initialize auxiliary fields and seek an active32-byte source object. Copy its subtype and position, choose graphic/sound, then derive motion toward the player.

units.name: FindAuxiliarySource
units.summary: Walk eight source slots, requiring both the auxiliary sign flag and active sign bit.

units.name: CopyAuxiliarySource
units.summary: Save the selected source position and index and copy its low three subtype bits into the destination. The shared graphic/sound continuation restores the position and activates the auxiliary record.

units.name: SetAuxiliaryObjectGraphicAndSound
units.summary: Use A as a coordinate-pair index and Y as the auxiliary record offset. Store its graphic byte, request the paired sound and restore X after that bank-switching call.

units.name: AimAuxiliaryObjectAtPlayer
units.summary: Compute signed horizontal/vertical distances from an auxiliary object to the player, with a scroll-dependent vertical correction. Make the larger velocity magnitude00FF and derive the smaller by the shared division helper; sign flags then complement the corresponding velocity pair.

units.name: ObjectCoordinatePairs
units.summary: Signed coordinate pairs read by indexed loads at CPU D06C/D06D. The full natural index domain remains unresolved.

units.name: ScaleAndSignAuxiliaryVelocity
units.summary: Clear the fractional motion field; parameter0F above1 scales both velocity pairs by1.5. Complement each pair according to the saved displacement sign before updating the auxiliary pool.

units.name: UpdateAuxiliaryPool
units.summary: Advance pseudo-random state, then visit five16-byte records at $0380. Negative state marks active; selected types call a banked helper before general update and player overlap.

units.name: NextAuxiliaryObject
units.summary: Advance OAM and record pointers by16, carrying into the record high byte.

units.name: ScaleAuxiliaryVelocityByThreeHalves
units.summary: Add half an unsigned16-bit velocity pair to itself, retaining fractional carry between the low/high bytes.

units.name: TestSmallPlayerOverlap
units.summary: Use a four-unit half extent, then clear the current state when the comparison falls through. The shared helper sets player bit0 for an overlap.

units.name: TestPlayerOverlap
units.summary: A/Y supply X/Y half extents. Unsigned modular differences test centered boxes; if both axes fit set player state bit0. Carry on early exit is preserved.

units.name: TestPlayerOverlapPrepared
units.summary: Enter with X/Y half extents already in WorkByteOrPtrLo/Hi; test the current object against player position.

units.name: TestLargePlayerOverlap
units.summary: Use six-unit half extents in both axes.

units.name: TestObjectWithWideBounds
units.summary: Select horizontal bound14 and vertical bound10 before the shared object test.

units.name: TestObjectWithNarrowBounds
units.summary: Select horizontal bound12 and vertical bound0C before the shared object test.

units.name: UpdateObjectRecord
units.summary: A mode/player gate admits type25 specially; resume saved continuation, spawn inactive objects as allowed, otherwise run collision tests and dispatch the low five type bits.

units.name: ResumeOrSpawnObject
units.summary: An inactive record may be reused depending on slot budget, spawn state and player mode. Active records proceed to collision/dispatch.

units.name: DispatchActiveObject
units.summary: Test projectile and thrown-object interactions, mask type to0..31 and call an inline return-address dispatch helper.

units.name: MainObjectDispatchTargets
units.summary: Thirty address-minus-one words for the main object dispatcher. Slots16 through19 are zero. Selectors30/31 would read the following helper opcodes; the mask does not establish two extra table words or natural selector use.

units.name: DispatchInlineWordTable
units.summary: A is a table index. Pop the JSR return into $07/$08, read a word beginning at return+2*A+1, push high then low, and RTS to target+1. Table words therefore encode address-minus-one; targets are not ordinary pointer proof of code.

units.name: RunTimedTransitionObject
units.summary: Initialize a16-bit countdown and attribute01. Yield through environment-paused frames until a projectile/thrown hit condition changes the sprite, then wait for player proximity. KindB0 takes the effect path; other kinds publish a target coordinate and environment flag20.

units.name: TickTransitionObjectCountdown
units.summary: KindB0 bypasses the countdown. Kind62 requires grenades; kinds09/25 also depend on the shared scroll counter. Decrement record22/23, derive a sprite progress tile, and set the player's hit flag if time or required inventory runs out.

units.name: RunTerrainAnimatedObject
units.summary: On terrain contact choose a random direction parameter and sprite base. Animate an inactive record for25 ticks before restoring its saved position, then alternate frames while testing player/projectile hits and applying directional motion.

units.name: ObjectMotionParameters
units.summary: Small object parameters read by CPU D354. Individual arrays and natural selectors remain unresolved.

units.name: RestoreObjectSavedPosition
units.summary: Copy saved coordinate fields23/24 back into X/Y fields2/4.

units.name: RunProximityActivatedMover
units.summary: Start inactive with a side-dependent sprite. Wait for the player to approach within a24-pixel vertical band, restore the saved position and activate; move/collide until the horizontal bound clears its state, then repeat.

units.name: ClearObjectAuxiliaryFlag
units.summary: Clear field19 of the selected32-byte object. Its game meaning remains unresolved.

units.name: RunAlternatingSteeringObject
units.summary: Set attribute02 and initial parameter01. Age bit5 alternates a scroll-only phase with a steering phase; refresh aim and direction sprites at phase boundaries, then check activity and both projectile hit sources each frame.

units.name: SelectSteeringObjectSprite
units.summary: Combine the direction lookup with age bit3 to choose one of two directional sprite banks.

units.name: RunHalfCycleDirectionalObject
units.summary: Frame-counter sign chooses two long phases. The negative phase periodically reaims and uses a direction-dependent sprite base; the positive phase animates walking, moves unless player state4 suppresses it and occasionally faces the player. Both preserve environment pause and collision behavior.

units.name: UpdateNegativeHalfCycleAim
units.summary: Every32 frames refresh aim/direction and save an indexed sprite base. Animate it with frame bits and schedule periodic object actions before collision tests.

units.name: UpdatePositiveHalfCycleMotion
units.summary: Animate from frame bits, move unless the player special state forbids it, and update the facing direction toward the player every16 frames.

units.name: ObjectPositionParameters
units.summary: Finite coordinate values read by CPU D4F3. Individual arrays and natural selectors remain unresolved.

units.name: RunHalfCycleStationaryObject
units.summary: Alternate an aimed directional animation with a two-frame animation according to the global frame sign. Each phase tests collisions and object activity; the positive phase also schedules an action.

units.name: ObjectThresholdAndFlagParameters
units.summary: Coordinate thresholds and binary fields read by CPU D543/D552 before the next code boundary. These need not share one record format.

units.name: InitializeCollectibleKind
units.summary: Normalize a low direction/kind bit through parameter tables, find its indexed entry and save that index in field25. Some entries begin a proximity/activation phase; others immediately use the falling/render path.

units.name: TickConditionalObject
units.summary: Yield, add scrolling displacement, test the bottom edge, and conditionally wait while overlapping the player. Types/directions $C0 and $64 have special checks.

units.name: CheckCollectibleApproach
units.summary: Apply scroll and compare player proximity before updating the collectible activation latches. A first encounter can set field27 and restart the conditional object path.

units.name: ChooseCollectibleAppearance
units.summary: A zero kind can disappear according to a random threshold, otherwise choose one of two sprite pairs and adjust its Y before the shared falling/render loop.

units.name: RunCollectibleUntilCollected
units.summary: Store the sprite selector, apply scroll, update attribute cycling and render. Exit at the lower screen edge; otherwise wait through environment pauses and dispatch the collected effect through field25 when the player enters the pickup window.

units.name: DeactivateObjectFragment
units.summary: Clear the current object state and return normally.

units.name: SecondaryObjectDispatchTargets
units.summary: Sixteen address-minus-one words selected through object field25 and the inline dispatcher. The table ends at the independently bounded CPU D670 helper; the global natural selector domain remains unresolved.

units.name: TestObjectBottomEdge
units.summary: Return comparison flags for object Y against240.

units.name: ApplyPaletteCollectibleEffect
units.summary: Disable rendering/NMI, upload the selected flash palette, restore rendering and NMI, then apply the shared pickup reward.

units.name: EnableModeTwentyPickup
units.summary: Set ModeFlagsOne bit5 and use the common pickup reward path.

units.name: EnableModeFortyPickup
units.summary: Set ModeFlagsOne bit6 and use the common pickup reward path.

units.name: EnableModeTenPickup
units.summary: Set ModeFlagsOne bit4 and use the common pickup reward path.

units.name: EnableModeEightPickup
units.summary: Set ModeFlagsOne bit3 and use the common pickup reward path.

units.name: ApplyPickupCounterEffect
units.summary: Supply amount05 and record index03 to the shared moving-object counter effect.

units.name: AwardLargePickupAmount
units.summary: Award the16-bit status amount with high byte10, then show the large pickup sprite.

units.name: AwardSmallPickupAmount
units.summary: Award the16-bit status amount with high byte01, then show the small pickup sprite.

units.name: AwardLifePickup
units.summary: Select the active player score bank and increment its leading counter. Request reward audio, show spriteCA for60 ticks and return.

units.name: CycleObjectAttribute
units.summary: Every fourth frame increment field9 modulo4; this is also used as the emitted sprite attribute.

units.name: ExitInactiveObjectContinuation
units.summary: An inactive record discards the current JSR return and clears type field16 before returning to the caller’s caller.

units.name: IncrementObjectAge
units.summary: Increment record offset7 modulo256.

units.name: RunRandomDirectionAnimatedObject
units.summary: Initialize Y and a direction flag, animate from a local frame counter with facing-dependent sprite groups, and periodically choose a new random direction parameter. Update steering and both projectile hit tests between yields.

units.name: RunTerrainOrSteeringObject
units.summary: Animate four frames and set the hidden-sprite flag. Kind17 uses terrain-axis movement with random direction changes and periodic actions; other kinds steer toward the player and gate periodic actions by distance.

units.name: SetPeriodicObjectField
units.summary: Every16 frames copy caller A to record offset19. Other frames leave it unchanged.

units.name: ChoosePeriodicObjectAction
units.summary: Use mission progression and two random bytes to decide whether to set the action parameter in field19. Its high bit marks the scheduled action; local frame bits can delay that mark.

units.name: StorePeriodicObjectAction
units.summary: Store the requested action, test its mask against the local frame counter and set bit7 when the scheduling condition is met.

units.name: RunPersistentApproachObject
units.summary: Reject a previously collected persistent object, then animate until Y reaches60. Thereafter move and test projectile hits until the selected environment/cull condition ends the continuation.

units.name: SelectFourFrameObjectSprite
units.summary: Use age bits to select one of four banked sprite pairs starting at0C.

units.name: SelectSplitFrameObjectSprite
units.summary: Use age bits to select the early frame range directly and the later range through a second two-frame bank.

units.name: LoadBankedSpritePair
units.summary: X selects a pair at banked CPU $8030; store it in record fields10/11. The caller supplies an even byte offset.

units.name: LoadAlternateSpritePair
units.summary: X selects a pair at banked CPU $813E; store it in record fields10/11.

units.name: CompareObjectEnvironmentBit
units.summary: XOR field26 with environment state $0510 and rotate bit0 into carry.

units.name: ClaimPersistentSpawnBit
units.summary: Unless the player is in special state4, split SpawnParameter into bitmap byte/bit indices. Global player bit1 selects the bitmap half. Set an unseen bit; if already set, pop this helper's caller return, clear the object and return from the continuation.

units.name: RunPersistentPickupApproach
units.summary: Claim the spawn bit, wait30 frames and clear attributes. Animate in place until the player approaches, then award the pickup, initialize motion and enter the collected-object animation.

units.name: ActivateCollectedObject
units.summary: Increment the mission amount, award status/audio, clear attributes and set a negative motion field. Record the collected spawn bit for special player mode, then animate and move with an environment-dependent sprite set.

units.name: MarkCollectedSpawnForSpecialPlayer
units.summary: For player state4, combine the current slot mask with the selected spawn-kind bitmap. Global player bit1 selects the current or alternate bitmap half.

units.name: RunPersistentTwoHitApproachObject
units.summary: Claim the spawn bit and initialize a two-hit latch. Animate until Y reaches60, then move and collide; once the hit latch reaches zero, change direction and reuse collected-object activation.

units.name: RenderFixedEffectSprite
units.summary: Select OAM offsetB8 and spriteAC before the shared object renderer.

units.name: RunPlayerTrackingLargeObject
units.summary: Request sound13. Area6 uses a different initial Y/vertical velocity; other areas start near the top. Follow the player's horizontal side in later missions, move and test overlap until ten projectile hits enter the large-object destruction sequence.

units.name: InitializeAreaSixTrackingObject
units.summary: Set Y10, vertical velocity0280, player-aligned X and zero hit counter.

units.name: InitializeTopTrackingObject
units.summary: Set Y08, direction04, player-aligned X and vertical velocity0140 before selecting sprite72.

units.name: TestLargeObjectTenHitThreshold
units.summary: Run projectile collision and return the comparison of record17 with ten.

units.name: HideStridedObjectSprites
units.summary: Write hidden Y to X OAM records through ObjectOamLo/Hi, advancing Y by four. Caller supplies nonzero count and a valid destination; natural caller is unknown.

units.name: TestLargeObjectPlayerOverlap
