units.summary: Compare player/object distances against0C on both axes. Within that box set the player's hit bit; the subtraction paths retain their existing carry convention.

units.name: RunDescendingAnimatedLargeObject
units.summary: Initialize the shared vertical velocity and fixed position, then animate, render/collide and move once per yielded frame using effect index09.

units.name: InitializeLargeObjectVelocity
units.summary: Set velocity fields12/13 to01C0 and clear attributes.

units.name: RunPlayerTrackingVerticalLargeObject
units.summary: Initialize position/velocity and choose sprite74/76 by direction. Move and render with effect0C; outside mission3, steer the vertical direction toward the player. Ten projectile hits enter destruction.

units.name: RunDelayedHorizontalLargeObject
units.summary: Start at Y60 with a movement limit and sprite78. Move until X falls belowA0, then hold a countdown or wait for a player alignment trigger before resuming pursuit. Thrown-object hits enter the common destruction path.

units.name: AnimateLargeObjectDestruction
units.summary: Clear attributes and step through sprite pairsA4/A6/A8/AA, ten frames each, then clear the object's active state with effect0C.

units.name: WaitForLargeObjectPursuit
units.summary: Yield and poll player alignment until it triggers, or until the local timer reaches78, then rejoin movement and collision checks.

units.name: AimLargeObjectWhenVerticallyAligned
units.summary: Except in mission1, require a16-pixel vertical window and choose left/right from the player's horizontal side. Return carry set when a new direction is installed.

units.name: SelectObjectEffect
units.summary: Rotate caller A to choose a small sprite index; player-record bank/mode flags may load an alternate pair. Reset attribute field9 and tail-call rendering.

units.name: RenderLargeObjectWithEffect
units.summary: Select effect0C and enter the shared rendering/activity wrapper.

units.name: RunDescendingContactObject
units.summary: Initialize Y=10, sprite7A and direction motion, then reserve OAM offset98. Yield while descending to Y70; afterward move by direction indefinitely. Both phases render, scroll and test contact, entering destruction on a hit. Sprite decoding requires bank6 in the lower windows; natural spawn selection is unknown.

units.name: DescendingContactPhase
units.summary: Render/scroll, test contact and yield until object Y reaches70.

units.name: DescendingContactYield
units.summary: Save the object continuation, then recheck the descent threshold next tick.

units.name: DirectionalContactPhase
units.summary: Continue rendering and direction motion after the descent threshold.

units.name: DirectionalContactYield
units.summary: Save the object continuation before the next movement tick.

units.name: RunTwoHitSingleSpriteObject
units.summary: Apply scroll and choose a graphic from player vertical distance and object horizontal side. Emit one sprite and cull/test activity. Latch each thrown-object contact so a continuous overlap decrements the two-hit counter only once; destruction follows the second distinct contact.

units.name: ObjectGraphicParameters
units.summary: Repeated E0/E4/E2 graphic parameters read at CPU DCE8. The full natural index domain remains unresolved.

units.name: GatePeriodicActionByPlayerDistance
units.summary: Schedule an action only when the player lies at least40 below and at least20 horizontally away. Otherwise clear field19 bit7. Preserve the requested action byte on the stack.

units.name: RequestLargeObjectSound
units.summary: Request sound13 through the bank-switching audio wrapper.

units.name: RunTimedLargeObjectAttack
units.summary: Move toward X80 with shared animation, then spend78 ticks cycling an attack sprite and periodic actions. Mode8 permits thrown-object destruction. After expiry request sound14, clear its auxiliary flag and resume perpetual movement.

units.name: RenderObjectOrExitToEffect
units.summary: Save the effect index, select the object's OAM offset and render/collide. If the state becomes zero, discard the caller return and enter the effect helper; otherwise return normally.

units.name: SelectLargeObjectWalkSprite
units.summary: Combine age bit2 with record16 bit0 to choose a banked walking sprite pair.

units.name: SelectLargeObjectSpriteOffset
units.summary: Add14 to the supplied animation offset and tail-call the banked sprite-pair lookup.

units.name: RunAimedObjectUntilPlayerCrossing
units.summary: Request sound19 and repeatedly aim/animate while testing hits. When the object is below60 and horizontally near the player outside mission3, set a horizontal direction and timed-motion fields before joining the timed object loop.

units.name: RunObjectUntilVerticalWindow
units.summary: Choose a sprite base from direction, clear age and repeatedly aim, animate and schedule actions. When the player is within20 below it, choose one of two random direction values and install a78-tick motion phase.

units.name: ExitObjectAtSelectedCullCode
units.summary: Compare A with the current cull code at scratch8E. On equality discard the caller return and jump to the culling exit path; otherwise return normally.

units.name: DispatchObjectMotionVariant
units.summary: Choose behavior from the direction low nibble:08 runs the scrolling animation,02 enters the aimed object path and other values choose a fixed side sprite.

units.name: RunScrollingAnimatedObject
units.summary: Check both hit sources and player overlap, choose an age-based sprite and render/collide. Exit at cull code04 and schedule periodic action04 while yielding.

units.name: SelectSideFacingObjectSprite
units.summary: Direction bit2 selects banked spriteD2 orD4 before rejoining the shared object frame path.

units.name: TickMovingObjectLoop
units.summary: Cycle attributes, render/move helpers, test player overlap and choose a direction-specific helper. Exit if inactive; otherwise yield and repeat.

units.name: AwardStandardObjectAmount
units.summary: Request sound1A, then award a status amount with low byte00 and high byte10.

units.name: AddPackedMissionAmount
units.summary: Add X to mission amount byte Y. Correct a low decimal digit that reaches ten by adding06; the helper preserves the original packed-byte representation.

units.name: AddMissionAmountAndSound
units.summary: Update the packed mission amount, then request sound1A.

units.name: ShowSmallPickupSprite
units.summary: Select alternate spriteD4 for the pickup presentation.

units.name: ShowLargePickupSprite
units.summary: Select alternate spriteD2 for the pickup presentation.

units.name: ShowDefaultPickupSprite
units.summary: Select alternate spriteD0 for the pickup presentation.

units.name: AnimatePickupReward
units.summary: Select the supplied alternate sprite and sound1A. Start age at07, render until age43, then award the standard object amount.

units.name: AwardObjectPickupReward
units.summary: Join the standard reward sound/amount path.

units.name: DeactivateCurrentObject
units.summary: Clear the current object state byte without inventing a further role for its remaining fields.

units.name: ComparePlayerWithinEight
units.summary: Return carry clear only when modular X and Y differences both lie within a16-unit box centered around the player.

units.name: RunRandomAgeAnimatedObject
units.summary: Seed age from the random byte, choose animation from its high/phase bits and schedule an action in a selected frame phase. Check thrown hits, render/collide, exit at cull04 and apply the special-player offscreen rule.

units.name: ExitObjectAboveScreenForSpecialPlayer
units.summary: When player state40 is set and object Y is negative, discard the caller return and deactivate the object; otherwise return normally.

units.name: SelectAgeAnimationOffset
units.summary: Increment age, clamp its nonnegative half to zero and extract a two-bit even animation offset from the negative half. Return with carry clear.

units.name: InitializeObjectDirectionTimer
units.summary: Set record17 to60 before the shared direction/steering continuation.

units.name: TickTimedObjectLoop
units.summary: Move, age, reject out-of-bounds/inactive state, run collisions and rendering. Decrement field17; its final48 ticks add a table-shaped Y displacement before clearing type16.

units.name: EndTimedObject
units.summary: Clear type16 and continue through a gap; the next classified fragment is not assumed contiguous.

units.name: UpdateObjectSteering
units.summary: Environment bit0 may yield. A zero field7 chooses a new direction; otherwise decrement it. Player/world mode and pseudo-random bits influence steering and a later obstacle test.

units.name: ChooseObjectDirection
units.summary: Object-slot budget and pseudo-random thresholds gate direction changes. Object bit0 and special player mode choose additional adjustments.

units.name: ChooseSignedDirectionPerturbation
units.summary: Select FF or01 from the incoming index bit and join the signed direction perturbation helper.

units.name: ChooseModeDirection
units.summary: Player bit6 sets an object flag/direction depending on the player X sign; remaining modes retain existing state.

units.name: StoreObjectDirectionWork
units.summary: Store X in object field20 before joining the shared steering-direction update.

units.name: PerturbObjectDirection
units.summary: Use low random bits to add -1,0 or1 to direction index20 modulo8, then read a direction mask from CPU $E60E.

units.name: ResetDirectionTimer
units.summary: Aim the object toward the player, then select field7 duration30 or50 from object state bit0.

units.name: DecrementDirectionTimer
units.summary: Count field7 down before common steering work.

units.name: UpdateSteeringRange
units.summary: Clear auxiliary field19. Test whether object is within a96-unit box around player; distant paths pass a value to the periodic-field helper.

units.name: TickSteeringCounter
units.summary: Increment field22 while below30 and move while terrain is present; at the threshold enter axis-by-axis terrain resolution.

units.name: MoveObjectWhileTerrainPresent
units.summary: If the terrain query is nonzero, move and render/collide. Otherwise set field22 to1E and enter the delayed object path.

units.name: ResolveObjectTerrainAxes
units.summary: Reset blocked-axis count; preserve position and direction, test one masked axis at a time with the terrain query, and restore blocked coordinates. Two blocked axes remap the direction parameter before the expiry counter path.

units.name: ExpireObjectAfterThirtyTicks
units.summary: Increment field22; keep rendering/colliding while below1E and deactivate when the threshold is reached.

units.name: RenderAndCollideObject
units.summary: Types below13 call the banked direction helper; test player overlap, screen bounds, add scroll and render.

units.name: FinishObjectFrame
units.summary: Screen-bound removal, scroll displacement and multi-sprite rendering form the shared frame tail.

units.name: SaveObjectMotion
units.summary: Save integer X/Y and direction in scratch RAM $051C/$0519/$051B; return direction in A with Y=6.

units.name: RestoreBlockedMotion
units.summary: Restore saved integer coordinates and direction, incrementing the blocked-axis count. Fractional bytes are retained.

units.name: MoveMaskedObjectAxis
units.summary: Caller A is the masked direction at Y=6; move once, then restore the original direction from scratch.

units.name: RemapObjectDirectionParameter
units.summary: Replace object direction field6 using the indexed E1CE parameter bytes.

units.name: ObjectModeParameters
units.summary: Small finite parameter values read at CPU E1CE. Individual arrays and natural selector bounds remain unresolved.

units.name: AddObjectScroll
units.summary: Add the per-frame scroll displacement to the object’s16-bit Y pair3/4.

units.name: InitializeSpawnedObject
units.summary: Clear31 bytes, then mission/scroll, random thresholds, spawn counters and player mode decide whether and where to activate a record.

units.name: CheckSpawnBudget
units.summary: Select fallback source offset16. Queue state and two counters gate additional random-threshold tests.

units.name: ChooseSpawnQueueSlot
units.summary: Queue state bits6/7 select a four-byte spawn record. The following initializer copies its position/kind/direction and installs the active object defaults.

units.name: SelectSpawnQueueVariant
units.summary: Prefer a flagged queue slot; otherwise fall back to offsets4 or0 before masking a pseudo-random selector.

units.name: CopySpawnY
units.summary: Copy queue offset2 into object Y, then decode the queued position/kind/direction and install the remaining active-object defaults.

units.name: InitializeObjectFromSpawnQueue
units.summary: Decode queue position, kind and direction bits into the current object. Set a30-tick age, equal00A8 velocity magnitudes, table-selected attributes and timer04 before marking the record active. A zero direction can choose05/06 randomly except for kind1C.

units.name: CompareSharedSpawnCounters
units.summary: Return the threshold comparison for scratch84 against0F, or scratch83 against03 when the first threshold is not met.

units.name: ChooseRandomSpawnVariant
units.summary: Combine random state bytes to choose an aligned four-byte position template. If blocked, try successive templates through offset1C; accept the first terrain-valid position.

units.name: TryObjectPositionTemplate
units.summary: Copy candidate X/Y from a four-byte template and query terrain. Return carry set when blocked; otherwise install kind/direction, motion defaults and active/sprite fields, returning carry clear.

units.name: ActivateObjectWithDefaultSprite
units.summary: Set sprite pointer8000 and state80; callers supply the other initialization fields.

units.name: ObjectIndexedParameters
units.summary: Small parameter arrays read at CPU E36B/E373. The combined block is non-code; individual array boundaries remain unresolved.

units.name: ClearObjectRecord
units.summary: Clear offsets0..30 of a32-byte record. Offset31, the high continuation byte, is intentionally left unchanged by this loop.

units.name: AimObjectTowardPlayer
units.summary: Choose left/right from horizontal distance. Beyond10 pixels, keep that cardinal direction; within10 combine a vertical direction only when vertical distance reaches20, and suppress horizontal movement within08 pixels.

units.name: TestProjectileObjectHits
units.summary: Scan six16-byte projectile records. Nonzero state and X/Y distances below8 mark projectile state81, then the kind-specific hit response updates durability or awards score and begins destruction.

units.name: ApplyProjectileHitByObjectKind
units.summary: Mask object kind to five bits. Kind1B deactivates immediately; durable kinds increment their hit counter; kind09 also decrements the shared two-hit latch. Other kinds award status and discard the caller return before entering destruction animation.

units.name: NextProjectileHitTest
units.summary: Advance the projectile index by16 and repeat for six entries.

units.name: TestThrownObjectHit
units.summary: A nonzero $045E effect enables collision. Mode flag3 forces the hit path; otherwise compare absolute X/Y deltas against20, doubled under mode bit0.

units.name: ApplyThrownObjectHit
units.summary: Award packed-decimal score amount000300 before applying the thrown-hit result for the current object kind.

units.name: ApplyThrownHitByObjectKind
units.summary: Kinds05 and19 upward, plus the0A..0C subrange, return a durable-hit carry result. Other kinds discard the caller return and enter the common destruction animation.

units.name: NoThrownObjectHit
units.summary: Return carry clear when the effect is absent or outside its box.

units.name: AnimateObjectDestruction
units.summary: Clear state and age, request sound18 and display eight sprite-pair frames for six ticks each while applying scroll. Kind02 uses an alternate sprite table; kind0E adds a fixed effect sprite. Selected kinds can leave a collectible; others exit through culling.

units.name: CullObjectAtScreenEdge
units.summary: Require X4..251 and Y4..235. Outside those bounds select a four-sprite removal group, clear active state and hide its OAM entries.

units.name: ClearObjectActiveState
units.summary: Clear record state; X supplies the number of OAM sprites to hide in the following helper.

units.name: HideObjectOamGroup
units.summary: Hide X OAM sprites by writing F0 to successive four-byte Y fields through ObjectOamLo. Y advances by four per sprite.

units.name: HideSingleObjectSprite
units.summary: Specialize the clear-state/OAM hide helper to one sprite.

units.name: CollisionMotionParameters
units.summary: Repeated collision/motion parameters between CPU E573 andE59B routines. Exact individual fields remain partly unresolved.

units.name: MoveObjectByDirection
units.summary: Direction bits0..3 select positive X, negative X, positive Y and negative Y. Fields12/13 and14/15 supply16-bit step pairs; positions are fractional/integer pairs1/2 and3/4. Negative paths deliberately enter SBC with carry clear.

units.name: MoveObjectNegativeX
units.summary: Direction bit1 subtracts the X step with the original initial borrow; do not normalize its carry convention.

units.name: MoveObjectPositiveY
units.summary: Direction bit2 adds the Y step as a16-bit pair.

units.name: MoveObjectNegativeY
units.summary: Direction bit3 subtracts the Y step with initial carry clear.

units.name: ObjectStateParameters
units.summary: Small finite state parameters read by CPU E60E. The natural selector domain remains unresolved.

units.name: RenderObjectSprites
units.summary: Read the sprite stream and OAM destination, apply environment masking, then emit count-prefixed four-byte records: relative Y, relative X, attribute delta, tile. Y=$FE redirects the source pointer; $FF hides the sprite at Y=$F0.

units.name: ReadSpriteRecord
units.summary: Advance the stream index. A Y byte below254 is relative;254 redirects to a new stream address and255 emits hidden Y.

units.name: RedirectSpriteStream
units.summary: Read low/high source bytes after the $FE marker and restart indexing from0. The original sprite count remains in effect.

units.name: EmitRelativeSpriteY
units.summary: Add object Y to the stream’s relative Y and write OAM Y; following fields add object X and attribute bias.

units.name: EmitSpriteFields
units.summary: Write OAM order Y,tile,attributes,X while consuming stream order Y,X,attributes,tile. Advance OAM by4 and decrement remaining sprite count.

units.name: MaskSpritesByEnvironment
units.summary: Some global/environment states discard this call’s return, exiting the caller renderer. Otherwise scroll-high values $F6/$F7 and area-specific X/Y windows can substitute a fixed sprite stream; normal paths return A=0.

units.name: CheckEnvironmentSpriteWindow
units.summary: Only two scroll-high values and non-type4 objects use the stage window. Area1 uses distance from X128; even areas use X103..150.

units.name: CheckEnvironmentSpriteY
units.summary: Combine object Y with scroll and use different vertical windows for the two scroll-high values.

units.name: UseMaskedSpriteStream
units.summary: Replace the current source pointer with CPU $E6F2. This helper’s A return is not normalized on this path.

units.name: NoSpriteMask
units.summary: Return zero without replacing the source pointer.

units.name: HiddenSpriteRecordBytes
units.summary: Known bytes of the E6F2 count04 sprite source. Hidden-Y FF records can omit later fields; the fourth record skips fields that overlap following code. No exclusive17-byte data object is claimed.

units.name: RenderTransitionObjectSprites
units.summary: Read count-prefixed sprite records through PrepareSpriteStream. The first object's field18 selects two vertical clipping conventions. Signed X/Y offsets are added to object position; offscreen coordinates hide or skip the sprite before writing tile/attribute fields.

units.name: RenderAlternateTransitionSpriteCoordinates
units.summary: Use the alternate vertical visibility convention selected by the first object field18. Add each horizontal offset, then share tile/attribute output and OAM advancement.

units.name: PrepareSpriteStream
units.summary: Load source pointer from record10/11 and OAM pointer from $F4/$F5. Stream byte0 is count; X starts0. A zero count would underflow in the renderer, so valid nonzero streams are a caller precondition.

units.name: WriteTransitionSpriteFields
units.summary: Store computed X, combine record attribute with object field9, and copy the tile byte into the current four-byte OAM record. Advance the stream index across all fields.

units.name: EmitSingleSprite
units.summary: Copy object Y,tile,attribute,X fields4,8,9,2 into the four-byte OAM destination.

units.name: AdvanceRandomState
units.summary: XOR bit1 of two state bytes into carry, then rotate the two-byte state right. This is a deterministic feedback shift register; no period claim is made.

units.name: DivideUnsignedFixedPointMagnitude
units.summary: Perform16 restoring-division iterations. Scratch1D:1E is the shifting16-bit dividend/quotient, scratch1B the divisor and scratch1C the remainder. Aimed auxiliary objects use this to scale the minor velocity relative to the major distance; a zero divisor is not specially rejected here.

units.name: MultiplyShiftRegisterByByte
units.summary: Clear the low accumulator, shift the three-byte 1C:1D:1E register sixteen times and add byte1B into 1E when the outgoing 1C bit is set, carrying into1D. The caller supplies operands; the returned representation is this in-place shift/add result. No natural caller is established.

units.name: MultiplyShiftRegisterLoop
units.summary: Shift one operand bit into carry; add the multiplicand only when set.

units.name: MultiplyShiftRegisterNextBit
units.summary: Count exactly sixteen shift/add iterations.

units.name: SelectActivePlayerScoreBank
units.summary: GlobalState bit1 selects the six-digit score bank at0480 or0486 and supplies the corresponding display offset.

units.name: AddPackedDecimalScoreAmount
units.summary: A:X:Y supplies three packed-decimal amount bytes. Split them into six decimal digits and add right-to-left into the active player's six-digit score, propagating decimal carry. A change in the selected leading threshold digit can award a life capped at9 and sound1D. Special player state40 also advances scratch84.

units.name: AddScoreDigitsWithCarry
units.summary: Walk six decimal digits from least to most significant. A digit reaching ten subtracts ten and carries one into the next digit; the active-player selector chooses its score base.

units.name: CheckScoreLifeThreshold
units.summary: Compare the saved/current score digit and use the routine's threshold/carry conditions before incrementing the life count. The exact later-threshold intent remains unresolved; preserve the existing CPY condition without assuming a regular extra-life schedule.

units.name: UpdateSpawnStream
units.summary: Move four queue records by scroll displacement and deactivate on carry. Parse control opcodes $FB..$FF and position-triggered spawn records through $F7/$F8.

units.name: ReadSpawnCommand
units.summary: Values below$FB are scroll-position triggers. $FF calls a separate parser; other control values set flags, copy parameters or change a spawn threshold.

units.name: ChooseSpawnCommandLengthOne
units.summary: Select a one-byte command length before the shared spawn-stream cursor update.

units.name: ReadSpawnParameter
units.summary: Copy the next spawn-stream byte into SpawnParameter and advance the command pointer by two bytes.

units.name: ReadSpawnModeParameters
units.summary: Copy exactly three mode parameters into RAM92..94, then advance the spawn-stream pointer by four bytes including the opcode.

units.name: ChooseSpawnCommandLengthFour
units.summary: Select a four-byte command length before the shared spawn-stream cursor update.

units.name: ReadSpawnThreshold
units.summary: Set $FA from the next stream byte, then advance through a shared helper.

units.name: MatchSpawnScrollPosition
units.summary: Require the first two record bytes to match current scroll low/high before interpreting spawn flags.

units.name: FilterMissionSpawnVariant
units.summary: A flagged subtype compares mission bits for selectors $49/$59/$69 and may skip eight bytes. These mission conditions are not proof of a naturally selected route.

units.name: SkipSpawnVariant
units.summary: Advance the stream pointer by8 using the carry from ADC.

units.name: ChooseSpawnQueueDestination
units.summary: Select queue class and find a destination by bit6. Mark its descriptor active, clear work state, set timer08 and copy the packed position before advancing the stream.

units.name: FindSpawnQueueDestination
units.summary: Walk four-byte queue records while bit6 is set. This loop has no explicit bound; valid stream/queue state is required.

units.name: InitializeQueuedSpawnFields
units.summary: Clear the queue work byte, set timer08 and copy the fourth stream byte into the queue's packed position field, then advance the stream by four.

units.name: CommitSpawnStreamPointer
units.summary: Store the new low pointer and carry into the high byte; continue parsing commands.

units.name: DispatchSpawnEndCommand
units.summary: For stream markerFF, queue a four-byte background spawn record and continue parsing commands.

units.name: QueueBackgroundSpawnRecord
units.summary: If the circular background queue slot is free, copy four bytes following the command into it, wrap the write offset modulo20 and advance the spawn stream by five. A busy slot uses the existing stream-commit path.

units.name: AdvanceSpawnStreamPointer
units.summary: Advance the spawn-stream pointer by A bytes with carry into its high byte.

units.name: RunSpawnTransitionTrigger
units.summary: Derive a persistent bitmap index from the spawn kind and return if already marked. Save kind/coordinates in the object, then wait through mode/unlock restrictions and thrown-hit gating. Render a trigger sprite until the player approaches, optionally mark persistence, set player special-state4, save coordinates and initialize the new spawn-kind layout.

units.name: ActivateSpawnTransitionTrigger
units.summary: Search the seven persistent-trigger kinds and set the selected bitmap bit when matched. Set player state4, save trigger X/Y, disable NMI and install the associated layout before selecting the object pool.

units.name: InitializeSpawnKindLayout
units.summary: Restore kind/coordinates from object saved fields, preserve the spawn-stream pointer and load several fixed record groups according to kind. Restore the stream, clear the inline RAM block and dispatch the kind through48 address-minus-one words. Natural selector bounds remain unresolved.

units.name: SpawnKindDispatchTargets
units.summary: Forty-eight address-minus-one words selected by spawn kind through the inline dispatcher. The independent CPU EC10 helper bounds the table; the full natural spawn-kind domain remains unresolved.

units.name: SpawnFixedRecordGroup
units.summary: Set the spawn-stream pointer from X:Y and enter the shared parameter-record helper with Y=FF so it begins at the first byte.

units.name: ObjectSelectionThresholds
units.summary: Sorted finite thresholds compared by the CPU EC19 indexed loop. Their game-facing units remain unresolved.

units.name: RunTwentyCoordinatePickups
units.summary: Build twenty three-byte records containing active80 and two coordinates from the40-byte source table. When global mode8 is active, render two sprites per live record and test the player's eight-pixel pickup window. Collected entries are cleared and award a packed mission amount plus sound.

units.name: RenderOrCollectCoordinatePickup
units.summary: Compare player position with the current pair. On pickup clear its active byte and hide two sprites; otherwise draw two tile3C sprites with frame-cycled attributes.

units.name: CollectCoordinatePickup
units.summary: Clear the triplet state, hide both OAM entries and award amount02 to mission counter3 while preserving both loop indices.

units.name: CoordinateTripletSources
units.summary: Twenty coordinate pairs. The CPU EC20 loop copies the two bytes of each pair into an output triplet and adds its third field; the source extent is exactly40 bytes.

units.name: SelectEnvironmentTransitionOne
units.summary: Select environment transition01 after loading the current spawn layout.

units.name: StoreEnvironmentTransitionSelection
units.summary: Store the supplied transition selector at0516 and enter its common activation path.

units.name: WaitForType14Objects
units.summary: Select object base02A0 and scan seven32-byte slots. An active type14 record yields and rescans; otherwise enter the transition activation below. Natural dispatch selection remains unknown.

units.name: ScanForActiveType14
units.summary: Inspect state, then type at offset16; preserve the current slot index across the type test.

units.name: RestoreType14ScanIndex
units.summary: Balance the saved Y on the nonmatching-type path.

units.name: AdvanceType14ScanSlot
units.summary: Advance one32-byte slot; a completed scan falls into transition activation.

units.name: YieldForType14Object
units.summary: Select the primary object0280 for the continuation save, yield one frame and restart the seven-slot scan next tick.

units.name: ActivateEnvironmentTransitionSelection
units.summary: Set selection bit7 and clear the first main object. The selected transition is interpreted by the player/environment presentation paths.

units.name: InitializeObjectsFromFourByteRecords
units.summary: X:Y points to a count followed by four-byte object records. Begin at RAM02A0 and initialize each successive32-byte slot while decrementing a seven-slot mask selector. Record count/selector domains are not independently widened here.

units.name: SelectFirstLayoutObjectSlot
units.summary: Set the current object pointer to02A0, leaving the primary slot0280 separate.

units.name: CopyLayoutObjectRecord
units.summary: Copy source X/Y into current and saved coordinate fields, direction into field6 and kind into field16. For persistent kinds14/1C, skip activation if the selected player's bitmap says collected. Otherwise extract source bit7 into field26 and activate the default sprite; advance both pointers.

units.name: ObjectOneHotMasks
units.summary: Eight one-hot masks indexed by the CPU EEAE bit-test/set paths.

units.name: SpawnObjectRecords
units.summary: Count-prefixed four-byte spawn/object parameter records addressed by the EDxx handlers. Individual record layouts and selector domains remain partly unresolved.

units.name: SecretAndCreditsMessages
units.summary: ASCII secret-keyword, birthday and credits text with display parameters. Individual parameter meanings remain partly unresolved.

units.name: DisplayUpdateEntry
units.summary: Fixed-bank display update and palette effect entry.

units.name: TerrainQueryEntry
units.summary: Return a two-bit collision-cell code for the current object.

units.name: RequestDefaultTransferAlias
units.summary: Fixed entry into the default pattern-transfer request.

units.name: RequestBackgroundTransferAlias
units.summary: Fixed entry into the background pattern-transfer request.

units.name: PrepareFirstTerrainRecordListEntry
units.summary: Fixed alias for the first saved terrain-record list.

units.name: PrepareSecondTerrainRecordListEntry
units.summary: Fixed alias for the second saved terrain-record list.

units.name: InitializeAreaStreamsEntry
units.summary: Fixed alias for area stream initialization and gameplay bank restoration.

units.name: CopyPaletteSourceToShadow
units.summary: Copy16 bytes from TileRowSource into the palette shadow, preserving the source pointer.

units.name: RememberRenderBankSelector
units.summary: Store the chosen16KiB mapper selector before the established render-bank switching path.

units.name: RestoreRenderBank
units.summary: Restore mapper2 selector from $C4. The preceding selector entry stores the requested mapper value before this restore path.

units.name: UpdateDisplayAndFlash
units.summary: Run the background update, then alternate two flash palettes when the thrown-object effect and mode bit3 are active.

units.name: UpdateBackground
units.summary: A nonzero palette request at $D7 selects16 bytes from banked CPU $9A20 plus the request value. Otherwise global/player/render flags route scrolling, terrain, tiles and palette work.

units.name: DispatchBackgroundMode
units.summary: Global bit5 exits; bit6 selects a special path. Player bit2 marks an environment latch before request flags are processed.

units.name: ProcessBackgroundRequests
units.summary: Process pending background requests. Bit7 initializes area streams and advances the row index; bit6 chooses the saved environment pointer. Stream flags can select a further pointer and render bank; callers must retain the supplied bank context.

units.name: AdvanceBackgroundRowFour
units.summary: Advance the background row index by four before applying its request-flag update.

units.name: CheckStreamBackgroundRequest
units.summary: Stream flag0 requests pointer $B134 and bank5, setting render transfer bits.

units.name: ConsumeSpawnStreamFlag
units.summary: Decrement the pending spawn-stream flag before the shared background mode continuation.

units.name: CheckGlobalBackgroundMode
units.summary: Global bit3 may invoke an additional helper before the player-state sign selects the transfer dispatcher.

units.name: RequestBackgroundTransferAfterStateChange
units.summary: Set render flag1, clear render flag2 and enter the default transfer request path.

units.name: DispatchBackgroundTransfer
units.summary: Render flag1 selects a staged tile transfer; player/global and render-state bits distinguish setup, second-phase and palette-only work.

units.name: ChooseBackgroundTransferPhase
units.summary: Use render-state bit4 to latch a one-time transfer; otherwise pick palette update paths from mode/global bits.

units.name: DispatchActiveRenderFlags
units.summary: Restore the render bank. Render flags0,3,7 and request bytes select row upload, bulk transfer, clearing or normal active rendering.

units.name: BeginActiveBackgroundRender
units.summary: Set render flag7 and process a pending row-index change. Index adjustment follows a24-byte grouping and four-byte alignment.

units.name: AdjustBackgroundRowIndex
units.summary: Clear request bit0 and choose a new aligned row index using remainder24 and several special remainders.

units.name: FallbackBackgroundRowIndex
units.summary: Use bits of the old index to subtract two or four before alignment.

units.name: CommitBackgroundRowIndex
units.summary: Align the background index to four, derive the bank6 area-pointer index and preserve the original value for the scroll-origin calculation.

units.name: LoadAreaSpawnStreamAndScrollOrigin
units.summary: Read the bank6 A010/A011 pointer, restore the render bank and derive the initial scroll high byte from the saved area parameter minus12 times AreaIndex, modulo16. Clear scroll fraction/Y before initializing render destinations.

units.name: BeginBackgroundRowHelper
units.summary: Initialize area streams before setting the terrain RAM and PPU destinations for the initial background rows.

units.name: InitializeTerrainAndPpuDestinations
units.summary: Set PPU destination2B80, terrain RAM destination06E0, render flagsC4 and a15-row work counter before clearing the pending pattern tail.

units.name: PackedTwoBitPatterns
units.summary: Four bytes00/55/AA/FF read by the CPU F731 indexed consumer; each repeats one two-bit value across the byte.

units.name: InitializeEnvironmentAttributes
units.summary: Initialize the environment transfer once, then choose a repeated two-bit attribute pattern from the kind low bits (kind2D uses zero). Fill all64 attribute bytes in both nametables.

units.name: FillNametableAttributePage
units.summary: Set low PPU addressC0 and emit64 copies of Y. The caller provides the nametable high byte.

units.name: InitializeEnvironmentGraphicsOnce
units.summary: Use environment bit1 as a one-time latch. Select mapper bank5, load its base pointer, decode bank bits, upload16 palette bytes and derive transfer bases. Install environment record lists and leave bank5 as the render-bank selection.

units.name: LoadEnvironmentRecordLists
units.summary: Index the bank5 B338 pointer table by kind+1. Save the first list pointer and its high flag as environment state; decode and draw it. A negative pointer flag introduces a second saved list, also decoded and drawn.

units.name: DrawEnvironmentRecordList
units.summary: Read six-byte records until FF. Each record supplies tile, PPU position, width, height and terrain value. Draw repeated two-row tile pairs, update the terrain rectangle and advance the pointer by six.

units.name: DrawEnvironmentTilePairRows
units.summary: Draw one tile-pair row, temporarily add10 to its tile base for the second row, then restore the base.

units.name: DrawEnvironmentTilePairRow
units.summary: Latch the supplied PPU address and repeat tile/tile|1 pairs across the record width. Advance the destination by20 to the next nametable row.

units.name: PrepareFirstTerrainRecordList
units.summary: Choose saved environment-list offset0, apply its terrain rectangles and restore mapper bank6.

units.name: PrepareSecondTerrainRecordList
units.summary: Choose saved environment-list offset2, apply its terrain rectangles and restore mapper bank6.

units.name: ApplySavedTerrainRecordList
units.summary: Select bank5, restore the saved list pointer and decode its bank/palette header. Apply each six-byte record's terrain rectangle until FF. The final high-byte increment branch retains its existing wrap behavior.

units.name: FillTerrainRectangleFromRecord
units.summary: Convert the PPU destination into a16-cell-wide terrain RAM index. Use record width/height and value to fill consecutive cells, advancing the starting index by10 hex for each row.

units.name: ProcessBackgroundQueue
units.summary: A mode bit skips normal queue work. A nonzero pending queue byte invokes a helper; otherwise consume a request at $0520+index.

units.name: CheckInitialScrollUploadWindow
units.summary: Initial FD scroll and negative player-control states use the shared upload path. FC scroll also qualifies while Y is at least C0; other states return.

units.name: ConsumeBackgroundQueueItem
units.summary: A zero queue item uses fallback mode logic. Otherwise latch its count, clear the queue slot, decode its source/destination fields and advance the circular read index.

units.name: DecodeQueuedBackgroundTransfer
units.summary: Load source low/high and the packed PPU destination from the current background queue record. Split its low bits into the destination word and wrap the read index modulo20.

units.name: CheckAreaBackgroundEffect
units.summary: Special player mode, mode flag4 and area index choose a timed palette/animation path or the shared environment effect path.

units.name: CheckEnvironmentBackgroundEffect
units.summary: Environment bit5 requests a transfer and is cleared; otherwise a negative $DD requests clearing PPU pattern bytes.

units.name: CheckModeBackgroundTransfer
units.summary: Mode bits5/6 gate a one-time transfer and set bit5 before its helper.

units.name: ClearPatternTableTail
units.summary: Write2048 zero bytes to PPU $1800..$1FFF using256 iterations of eight writes, then clear $DD.

units.name: TickAreaPaletteEffect
units.summary: Increment the progress counter while below33; frame phases0/3 choose one of two table columns, otherwise return.

units.name: SelectPaletteAnimationPhase
units.summary: Alternate entry derives an even phase index from frame bits4/5.

units.name: SelectAreaPalettePointer
units.summary: Combine phase and area-dependent offsets0/16/32, read a word at banked CPU $9A00, and queue a10x32 transfer descriptor at $04AD..$04B1.

units.name: ClearPendingPatternTail
units.summary: Clear the pending pattern-table tail, then consume the initial row counter while uploading alternating metatile rows.

units.name: UploadInitialBackgroundRows
units.summary: Consume the row counter while reading background pointers and alternating top/bottom metatile row uploads.

units.name: DecodeSourceBankAndPalette
units.summary: Extract mapper bank4..7 from the encoded source high byte, select it, normalize the CPU pointer into8000..BFFF and copy16 palette bytes to the shadow.

units.name: UploadScrolledTileRow
units.summary: Only run with nonzero scroll displacement. At a row boundary, read and advance a pointer from CPU $FE4A; $FF high byte wraps the table index to0.

units.name: ReadBackgroundRowPointer
units.summary: Read the selected word into $A1/$A2; increase table byte offset by2. A high byte$FF restarts from the first entry.

units.name: InitializeMetatileTransferBases
units.summary: Upload16 palette bytes, advance to the64-byte attribute page and upload it, then derive metatile transfer/header pointers. Set render request flags and choose their phase from ScrollHigh bit0.

units.name: UploadTopMetatileRow
units.summary: Latch PPU position and save a second-row address. Each of16 two-byte metatile records yields two tile bytes by combining bits0..2 and3..5 with a scroll-page contribution.

units.name: EmitTopTilePairs
units.summary: Output adjacent even/odd tile pairs. Records advance by2, leaving their attribute byte for the collision/shadow phase.

units.name: AdvanceBackgroundSource
units.summary: Advance source by32 bytes and subtract64 from the next PPU address; wrap between the appropriate nametable rows.

units.name: UploadBottomMetatileRow
units.summary: Clear transfer bit1 and write the lower tile pair for each of16 records using the saved source/address. Then copy odd record bytes into the RAM terrain-cell ring.

units.name: EmitBottomTilePairs
units.summary: Use the top-row tile formula plus16, then emit even/odd pairs.

units.name: CopyTerrainCellRow
units.summary: Read odd bytes from the metatile records and pack16 bytes through the terrain-ring pointer. Subtract16 from its low byte and wrap $F0 to$E0.

units.name: UploadCurrentAttributePage
units.summary: Choose nametable23C0 or2BC0 from ScrollHigh bit0 and copy64 bytes from the current source pointer.

units.name: QueryTerrainCell
units.summary: Combine object Y, scroll and a32-pixel bias into a16-row cell index; object X contributes its high nibble. Fine X/Y bits choose one of four two-bit quadrants in RAM $0600.

units.name: ExtractTerrainQuadrant
units.summary: Rotate the packed cell right twice per quadrant and return low two bits. No semantic names for terrain codes0..3 are assumed.

units.name: ReadFirstTerrainQuadrant
units.summary: Quadrant0 returns the unrotated low two bits.

units.name: BeginModeTransfer
units.summary: Select mapper bank0, then upload two256-byte pages from CPU8000 to PPU0000.

units.name: UploadTwoPatternPages
units.summary: Set PPU destination0000 and copy512 bytes from CPU8000 upward in the currently selected source bank. This helper does not establish that bank independently.

units.name: RequestSpecialTransfer
units.summary: If $054C is nonnegative use parameters $B8/$10 for the shared transfer helper.

units.name: QueueFullPatternTransfer
units.summary: Queue20 hex64-byte chunks from CPU8000 to PPU0000, then select the next queued-transfer phase.

units.name: RequestBackgroundTransfer
units.summary: Use source high A8, destination high00 and count40 hex64-byte chunks for the shared transfer setup.

units.name: RequestTransferWithOffset16
units.summary: Alternate setup supplies Y=10 and always branches into the shared A0-source request. X and remaining guards are set there.

units.name: RequestDefaultTransfer
units.summary: Use parameters $A0/$18 unless $054C is negative; render flag2 can suppress setup.

units.name: SetDefaultTransferSource
units.summary: Select source highA0 and apply the shared transfer-state/render guards, preserving the alternate Y offset.

units.name: RequestTransfer32
units.summary: Alternate entry supplies count20 hex64-byte chunks to the shared helper.

units.name: StartTransferHelper
units.summary: Queue the caller-supplied chunk count A and source/destination setup X/Y through QueuePatternChunkTransfer, then select bank0 and upload queued64-byte chunks.

units.name: RestoreBankZero
units.summary: Select mapper bank0 before uploading the queued64-byte pattern chunks. The selected bank changes both lower CPU windows.

units.name: UploadQueuedPatternChunks
units.summary: Copy64-byte source chunks to the current PPU destination. Advance both low pointers by40 and carry into their high bytes, decrementing the remaining chunk count; mark render flag1 when finished.

units.name: QueuePatternChunkTransfer
units.summary: Save chunk count A, source high X and destination high Y. Clear their low pointers and set render flag2 for the pending transfer.

units.name: UploadTwoBackgroundChunks
units.summary: Upload one32-byte chunk and, when the remaining-count result is nonzero, upload a second chunk.

units.name: UploadBackgroundChunk
units.summary: Select mapper bank1, write32 bytes from the queued source to the queued PPU destination and advance both pointers by20. Decrement the remaining background chunk count.

units.name: InitializePackedTransfer
units.summary: Render flag4 latches initialization: count32, variant-dependent stride16/24, clear counters and set source pointer to $B2/$B3+32.

units.name: ReadPackedTransferByte
units.summary: Reload the eight-bit packed shift register when empty and advance its source pointer. The continuation combines those bits with metatile data to select banked32-byte strips.

units.name: ContinuePackedTransfer
units.summary: Restore the selected render bank before decoding the next packed metatile transfer.

units.name: DecodePackedMetatileTransfer
units.summary: Decode a packed source byte and shift-register carry into a CPU pointer and mapper bank2/3. Upload two32-byte strips into adjacent output pages, advance the destination row/source cursor and stop or continue according to the remaining count and initial-scroll special case.

units.name: UploadPackedMetatileStrip
units.summary: Set the PPU address from packed output high/low fields and copy32 bytes through the decoded source pointer in the current mapper bank.

units.name: InitializeAreaStreamsAndRestoreGameplayBank
units.summary: Initialize the area spawn/background stream state, then restore mapper bank6.

units.name: InitializeAreaStreams
units.summary: Compute background row offset as24 times AreaIndex, select bank6 and load the A000/A001 area stream pointer. Restore the previous render-bank selection on exit.

units.name: GraphicsIncrementParameters
units.summary: A monotonic little-endian table advances by0254, followed by repeated parameters near graphics consumers. The full format and generating formula remain unresolved.

units.name: ResetPpuLatchAndStrobeController
units.summary: Read PPUSTATUS to reset its address latch, pulse controller strobe1 then0, and return X=0. A contains the status read; natural caller is unknown.

units.name: FinalStaffText
units.summary: Staff-credit ASCII plus smaller leading/trailing parameter fields. Exact meanings of those fields remain unresolved; hardware vectors begin separately at physical02000A.
